وَإِذَا تَوَلَّىٰ سَعَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُفْسِدَ فِيهَا وَيُهْلِكَ ٱلْحَرْثَ وَٱلنَّسْلَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْفَسَادَ

**2:206** E asinavin towen ses told, “bewar op Yowbad,” his prid mgwey towen to singay sin. Wadiginasim ses deis giyan towen — dreadpul abod.

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلْعِزَّةُ بِٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ فَحَسْبُهُۥ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

**2:207** E among gamag ses towen am-towen gimwal dimlen nev Yowbad approval. Yowbad ses kind towards servants.

وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْرِى نَفْسَهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

**2:208** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Siw siw wanuwan submission, wholeheartedly, e vag nag bukun pootsteps op Seitan; towen ses to yakamiy outrigt tameiliw.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ فِى ٱلسِّلْمِ كَآفَّةًۭ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

**2:209** Ge kukin yakamiy slip apter proops hav am to yakamiy, kakin towen Yowbad ses powerpul e wis.

فَإِن زَلَلْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْكُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

**2:210** Nisesus tasiyas kayamat giyan Yowbad dimlen to am to tem wa- kululuwan op livaboy, sisiyas son takayob, e mamagin matter ses settled? Babaw wuliyoug nisesus siwlayum to Yowbad.

هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ظُلَلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْغَمَامِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

**2:211** Gan gamagal op Yisleil amawan babaw gimagim mulin we hav given tem. Kal alters blessing op Yowbad apter kawegeis has am to towen — Yowbad ses singay avakaein wa- retribution.

سَلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ كَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۭ بَيِّنَةٍۢ ۗ وَمَن يُبَدِّلْ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

**2:212** Beautipied ses mwamovan op towen ven watinow giyan siyas am-towen yakaein, e tasiyas gin siyas am-towen kamiyeb. Ge rigteous nanon be wanakaew tem wakunuwatan yam op resurrektion. Yowbad provides to whomever towen nanon witout takwen.

زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَسْخَرُونَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۘ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

**2:213** Humanity used to be kweitan kommunity; mo Yowbad sent palopit, bringing bwein bulagan e sek warnings. E towen sent watinow son tem skriptur, son kamounid, to kaleiwag wanuwein gamag regarding teir dipperenses. Ge naga tonen dippered over kawegeis tage nag siyas am-towen wer given kawegeis — apter proops had am to tem — out op mutual envy wanuwein tem. Mo Yowbad katimlakay siyas am-towen kamiyeb to kamounid tasiyas had disputed, wa- akkordans son his nanon. Yowbad katimlakay kal towen nanon to damoms ked.

كَانَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ وَأَنزَلَ مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فِيمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ فِيهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ فَهَدَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

**2:214** Adok vag yakamiy dok to siw paradis kweiboug eksampl op siyas am-towen neim kweiboug yakamiy had token yakamiy? Adversity e hardsip had applikted tem, e tasiyas wer so saken wanakaew, towen takayob e siyas am-towen kamiyeb son towen said, “asinavin ses Yowbad tagagay?” bo, Yowbad tagagay ses kadiyakus.

أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِكُم مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُم ۖ مَّسَّتْهُمُ ٱلْبَأْسَآءُ وَٱلضَّرَّآءُ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ مَتَىٰ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ نَصْرَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌۭ

**2:215** Tasiyas gan yakamiy what tasiyas sould sek. Dibek, “whatever muloul yakamiy sek ses giyan parents, e dal, e orpans, e poor, e wayparer. Whatever bwein yakamiy vag, Yowbad ses awar op kawegeis.

يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ ۖ قُلْ مَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَلِلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:216** Kanaviy ses ordained giyan yakamiy, kadilok toug yakamiy dislik kawegeis. Ge kawegeis may be towen yakamiy dislik kweitan youd whil kawegeis ses bwein giyan yakamiy, e kawegeis may be towen yakamiy gig kweitan youd whil kawegeis ses bad giyan yakamiy. Yowbad kakin, e yakamiy vag nag kakin.

كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّۭ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

**2:217** Tasiyas gan yakamiy about kanaviy igawa bwanabwein tibukon. Dibek, “kanaviy igawa kawegeis ses deplorabl; ge to bar oters prom Yowbad ked, e to yakaein wa- towen, e to gidem aksess to bwanabwein mosk, e to ekspel kawegeis gamag prom kawegeis, nisesus singay deplorabl son Yowbad. E persekution ses singay serious tan katimet. Tasiyas nanon nag seas to kanaviy yakamiy ee tasiyas kanavin yakamiy kuyeim prom your religion, kukin tasiyas kadilok. Kal among yakamiy kanavin kuyeim prom his religion, e kanig disbeliever — siyas nisesus tasiyas whos wotet nanon am to nag, wa- towen mwamovan, e wa- hereapter. Siyas nisesus inmates op kov, abiding wa- kawegeis bisigeg.

يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلْحَرَامِ قِتَالٍۢ فِيهِ ۖ قُلْ قِتَالٌۭ فِيهِ كَبِيرٌۭ ۖ وَصَدٌّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَكُفْرٌۢ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَإِخْرَاجُ أَهْلِهِۦ مِنْهُ أَكْبَرُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلْفِتْنَةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ ٱلْقَتْلِ ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَن دِينِكُمْ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يَرْتَدِدْ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِۦ فَيَمُتْ وَهُوَ كَافِرٌۭ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

**2:218** Siyas am-towen kamiyeb, e siyas am-towen migrated e pougt giyan sak op Yowbad — siyas look porward to Yowbad nok nuwan. Yowbad ses porgiving e nok nuwan.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

**2:219** Tasiyas gan yakamiy about intoksikants e gambling. Dibek, “one ses gross sin wa- tem, e musinis peinan giyan gamag, ge teir sinpulness outweigs teir peinan.” e tasiyas gan yakamiy about what tasiyas sould sek: dibek, “ surplus.” mamagin Yowbad eksplains revelations to yakamiy, so towen yakamiy may dik.

۞ يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلْمَيْسِرِ ۖ قُلْ فِيهِمَآ إِثْمٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَإِثْمُهُمَآ أَكْبَرُ مِن نَّفْعِهِمَا ۗ وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ قُلِ ٱلْعَفْوَ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ

**2:220** About towen ven watinow e nekst. E tasiyas gan yakamiy about orpans. Dibek, “improvement giyan tem ses bwein singay. E kukin yakamiy intermiks son tem, mo tasiyas nisesus your bretren.” Yowbad kakin disonest prom honest. Had Yowbad nanon, towen kould hav overburdened yakamiy. Yowbad ses migty e wis.

فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۗ وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ ۖ قُلْ إِصْلَاحٌۭ لَّهُمْ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَإِن تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

**2:221** Vag nag vay idolatresses, unless tasiyas hav kamiyeb. Kamiyeb maid ses bwein tan idolatress, kadilok kukin yakamiy gig nawen. E vag nag vay idolaters, unless tasiyas hav kamiyeb. Kamiyeb servant ses bwein tan idolater, kadilok kukin yakamiy gig towen. Yamwag dow to kov, ge Yowbad dow to bag e to porgiveness, by his leav. Towen bub gimagim his kommunikations to gamag, towen tasiyas may be mindpul.

وَلَا تَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنَّ ۚ وَلَأَمَةٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَةٌ خَيْرٌۭ مِّن مُّشْرِكَةٍۢ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تُنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ وَلَعَبْدٌۭ مُّؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌۭ مِّن مُّشْرِكٍۢ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكُمْ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ وَيُبَيِّنُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**2:222** E tasiyas gan yakamiy about menstruation: dibek, “kawegeis ses harmpul, so keep move prom nummwey igawa menstruation. E vag nag approak tem ee tasiyas hav mlavag bwein. Sivatan tasiyas hav mlavag bwein, approak tem wa- ked Yowbad has katidumwal yakamiy.” Yowbad pwakit repentant, e towen pwakit siyas am-towen keep gimagim.”

وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًۭى فَٱعْتَزِلُوا۟ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فِى ٱلْمَحِيضِ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ ۖ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّٰبِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ

**2:223** Your nummwey nisesus kultivation giyan yakamiy; so approak your kultivation whenever yakamiy gig, e send ahead giyan yourselves. E goul Yowbad, e kakin towen yakamiy nanon kalivet towen. E sek bwein bulagan to believers.

نِسَآؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌۭ لَّكُمْ فَأْتُوا۟ حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّىٰ شِئْتُمْ ۖ وَقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُم مُّلَٰقُوهُ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**2:224** E vag nag allow your tabudabod wa- Yowbad yagan to kabiyun yakamiy prom virtu, e rigteousness, e bub niwal wanuwein gamag. Yowbad ses listener e knower.

وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عُرْضَةًۭ لِّأَيْمَٰنِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ وَتُصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:225** Yowbad vag nag yous yakamiy responsibl giyan your unintentional tabudabod, ge towen yous yakamiy responsibl giyan your intentions. Yowbad ses porgiving e porbearing.

لَّا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغْوِ فِىٓ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا كَسَبَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌۭ

**2:226** Siyas am-towen vow abstinens prom teir wives must kayamat giyan kweivas tibukon. Ge kukin tasiyas rekonsil — Yowbad ses porgiving e nok nuwan.

لِّلَّذِينَ يُؤْلُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ تَرَبُّصُ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍۢ ۖ فَإِن فَآءُو فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

**2:227** E kukin tasiyas resolv to peiyaw — Yowbad ses kataluteg e kakin.

وَإِنْ عَزَمُوا۟ ٱلطَّلَٰقَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:228** Peiyaw nummwey sall kayamat by tatineis giyan kweitoun periods. E kawegeis ses nag lawpul giyan tem to konseal what Yowbad has bub wa- teir sinvanun, kukin tasiyas kamiyeb wa- Yowbad e last yam. Meanwhil, teir mwan hav bwein kadilok to kew tem kuyeim, kukin tasiyas met rekonsiliation. E nummwey hav kadilok similar to teir obligations, akkording to what ses pair. Ge tawaw hav degre over tem. Yowbad ses migty e wis.

وَٱلْمُطَلَّقَٰتُ يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ ثَلَٰثَةَ قُرُوٓءٍۢ ۚ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ أَن يَكْتُمْنَ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ فِىٓ أَرْحَامِهِنَّ إِن كُنَّ يُؤْمِنَّ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۚ وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ أَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ إِنْ أَرَادُوٓا۟ إِصْلَٰحًۭا ۚ وَلَهُنَّ مِثْلُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ وَلِلرِّجَالِ عَلَيْهِنَّ دَرَجَةٌۭ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ

**2:229** Peiyaw ses allowed twis. Mo, eiter honorabl retention, adok setting pre kindly. Kawegeis ses nag lawpul giyan yakamiy to kew kuyeim anyting yakamiy hav given tem, unless tasiyas goul towen tasiyas kannot maintain Yowbad limits. Kukin yakamiy goul towen tasiyas kannot maintain Yowbad limits, mo one ses nag kavnek wakunuwatan tem kukin manawen sakripises kweitan youd giyan nawen kilev. Yamwag nisesus Yowbad limits, so vag nag transgress tem. Siyas am-towen transgress Yowbad limits nisesus unyust.

ٱلطَّلَٰقُ مَرَّتَانِ ۖ فَإِمْسَاكٌۢ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌۢ بِإِحْسَٰنٍۢ ۗ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَن تَأْخُذُوا۟ مِمَّآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّآ أَن يَخَافَآ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا فِيمَا ٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِۦ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَعْتَدُوهَا ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

**2:230** Kukin towen peiyaw nawen, manawen sall nag be lawpul giyan towen sivyuwein ee manawen has married kweitan mwan. Kukin latter peiyaw nawen, mo one ses nag kavnek wakunuwatan tem giyan reuniting, provided tasiyas dik tasiyas kadilok maintain Yowbad limits. Yamwag nisesus Yowbad limits; towen bub tem gimagim to gamag am-towen kakin.

فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا تَحِلُّ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدُ حَتَّىٰ تَنكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُۥ ۗ فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَآ أَن يَتَرَاجَعَآ إِن ظَنَّآ أَن يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ يُبَيِّنُهَا لِقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ

**2:231** Asinavin yakamiy peiyaw nummwey, e tasiyas hav token teir term, eiter retain tem amikably, adok kilev tem amikably. Ge vag nag retain tem to hurt tem e kommit aggression. Kal vag towen has bol dimlen. E vag nag kew Yowbad revelations giyan yok. E nuw Yowbad pavor to yakamiy, e towen towen kamtel to yakamiy skriptur e sinap to kamtilakay yakamiy. E goul Yowbad, e kakin towen Yowbad ses awar op everyting.

وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ سَرِّحُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوهُنَّ ضِرَارًۭا لِّتَعْتَدُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًۭا ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:232** Asinavin yakamiy peiyaw nummwey, e tasiyas hav token teir term, vag nag gidem tem prom vay teir mwan, provided tasiyas tam wakunuwatan pair terms. Tereby ses advised kal among yakamiy kamiyeb wa- Yowbad e last yam. Towen ses bwein e singay desent giyan yakamiy. Yowbad kakin, e yakamiy vag nag kakin.

وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ أَن يَنكِحْنَ أَزْوَٰجَهُنَّ إِذَا تَرَٰضَوْا۟ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ مِنكُمْ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۗ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

**2:233** Inan may nurs teir inpants giyan akweiy son bweilim, giyan siyas am-towen met to iwnawes nursing-period. Kawegeis ses duty op taman to provid giyan tem e klot tem wa- proper manner. Nag soul sall be burdened beyond kawegeis kapasity. Nag inan sall be yableb wakunuwatan akkount op nawen gwad, e nag taman sall be yableb wakunuwatan akkount op his gwad. Katanok-wan duty rests upon heir. Kukin koupl met weaning, by mutual itames e konsultation, tasiyas kommit nag yaweid by vag so. Yakamiy kommit nag yaweid by hiring nursing-inan, aveiyov yakamiy pay tem pairly. E be wary op Yowbad, e kakin towen Yowbad ses kin op what yakamiy vag.

۞ وَٱلْوَٰلِدَٰتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَٰدَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ ۖ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ ٱلرَّضَاعَةَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْمَوْلُودِ لَهُۥ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَا تُضَآرَّ وَٰلِدَةٌۢ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوْلُودٌۭ لَّهُۥ بِوَلَدِهِۦ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْوَارِثِ مِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ ۗ فَإِنْ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَن تَرَاضٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٍۢ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا ۗ وَإِنْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن تَسْتَرْضِعُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا سَلَّمْتُم مَّآ ءَاتَيْتُم بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ

**2:234** Giyan siyas among yakamiy am-towen kanig e leav kubuyen kuyeim, teir kubuyen sall kayamat by tatineis giyan kweivas tibukon e sinawatan yam. Asinavin tasiyas hav token teir term, one ses nag kavnek wakunuwatan yakamiy regarding what tasiyas adok honorably vag son tatineis. Yowbad ses pully akkainted son what yakamiy vag.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًۭا يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَعَشْرًۭا ۖ فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا فَعَلْنَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

**2:235** Yakamiy kommit nag yaweid by announsing your engagement to nummwey, adok by keeping kawegeis to yourselves. Yowbad kakin towen yakamiy nanon be dik about tem. Ge vag nag kalivet tem sekretly, unless yakamiy hav kweitan youd proper to dibek. E vag nag konpirm marriag tie ee lel ses pulpilled. E kakin towen Yowbad kakin what ses wa- your souls, so bewar op towen. E kakin towen Yowbad ses porgiving e porbearing.

وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا عَرَّضْتُم بِهِۦ مِنْ خِطْبَةِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ أَوْ أَكْنَنتُمْ فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ سَتَذْكُرُونَهُنَّ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُوَاعِدُوهُنَّ سِرًّا إِلَّآ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًۭا مَّعْرُوفًۭا ۚ وَلَا تَعْزِمُوا۟ عُقْدَةَ ٱلنِّكَاحِ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ أَجَلَهُۥ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌۭ

**2:236** Yakamiy kommit nag yaweid by peiyaw nummwey kweiboug having kabikon tem, adok kweiboug having set dowry giyan tem. E kompensat tem — wealty akkording to his gidukis, e poor akkording to his gidukis — son pair kompensation, duty upon doers op bwein.

لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِن طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ مَا لَمْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ أَوْ تَفْرِضُوا۟ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةًۭ ۚ وَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ عَلَى ٱلْمُوسِعِ قَدَرُهُۥ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُقْتِرِ قَدَرُهُۥ مَتَٰعًۢا بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**2:237** Kukin yakamiy peiyaw tem kweiboug yakamiy hav kabikon tem, ge apter yakamiy had set dowry giyan tem, sek tem halp op what yakamiy spesipied — unless tasiyas porego kadilok, adok kweitan wa- whos nim ses marriag kontrakt poregoes kawegeis. Ge to porego ses nearer to piety. E vag nag numlev generosity wanuwein kweitan kweitan. Yowbad ses kin op everyting yakamiy vag.

وَإِن طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةًۭ فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يَعْفُونَ أَوْ يَعْفُوَا۟ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ عُقْدَةُ ٱلنِّكَاحِ ۚ وَأَن تَعْفُوٓا۟ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَنسَوُا۟ ٱلْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**2:238** Guard your prayers, e middl prayer, e tabalawaw kweiboug Yowbad wa- devotion.

حَٰفِظُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلصَّلَوَٰتِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱلْوُسْطَىٰ وَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ قَٰنِتِينَ

**2:239** Ge kukin yakamiy nisesus wa- goul, mo wakunuwatan kaken, adok sisawl. E asinavin yakamiy nisesus sap, nuw Yowbad, towen taugt yakamiy what yakamiy bo ivag nag kakin.

فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالًا أَوْ رُكْبَانًۭا ۖ فَإِذَآ أَمِنتُمْ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَمَا عَلَّمَكُم مَّا لَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْلَمُونَ

**2:240** Siyas op yakamiy am-towen kanig e leav wives kuyeim — nanon sall provid teir wives son support giyan bweilim, provided tasiyas vag nag leav. Kukin tasiyas leav, yakamiy nisesus nag to kavnek giyan what tasiyas vag son tatineis, provided kawegeis ses reasonabl. Yowbad ses migty e wis.

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَصِيَّةًۭ لِّأَزْوَٰجِهِم مَّتَٰعًا إِلَى ٱلْحَوْلِ غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍۢ ۚ فَإِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى مَا فَعَلْنَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ مِن مَّعْرُوفٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

**2:241** E peiyaw nummwey sall be provided giyan, ekitably — duty upon rigteous.

وَلِلْمُطَلَّقَٰتِ مَتَٰعٌۢ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ حَقًّا عَلَى ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

**2:242** Yowbad mamagin eksplains his revelations to yakamiy, so towen yakamiy may kabunik.

كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

**2:243** Hav yakamiy nag dik siyas am-towen pled teir ven, by tousands, pearpul op kanig? Yowbad said to tem, “kanig.” mo towen revived tem. Yowbad ses grasious towards gamag, ge avakaein gamag nisesus nag appresiativ.

۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمْ وَهُمْ أُلُوفٌ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مُوتُوا۟ ثُمَّ أَحْيَٰهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

**2:244** Kanaviy wa- silawun op Yowbad, e kakin towen Yowbad ses kataluteg e kakin.

وَقَٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:245** Am-towen ses towen am-towen nanon opper Yowbad generous loan, so towen nanon multiply kawegeis giyan towen manipold? Yowbad kow e amplipies, e to towen yakamiy nanon be siwlayum.

مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥٓ أَضْعَافًۭا كَثِيرَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَقْبِضُ وَيَبْصُۜطُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**2:246** Hav yakamiy nag dik notables op gamagal op Yisleil apter Moses? Asinavin tasiyas said to palopit op teirs, “appoint king giyan us, e we nanon kanaviy wa- silawun op Yowbad.” towen said, “ses kawegeis bweina towen, kukin kanaviy was ordained giyan yakamiy, yakamiy would nag kanaviy?” tasiyas said, “why would we nag kanaviy wa- silawun op Yowbad, asinavin we wer driven out op our ven, along son our gamagal?” ge asinavin kanaviy was ordained giyan tem, tasiyas kanavin move, tage nag giyan pew op tem. Ge Yowbad ses awar op wrongdoers.

أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِنَبِىٍّۢ لَّهُمُ ٱبْعَثْ لَنَا مَلِكًۭا نُّقَٰتِلْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ هَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ أَلَّا تُقَٰتِلُوا۟ ۖ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نُقَٰتِلَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ أُخْرِجْنَا مِن دِيَٰرِنَا وَأَبْنَآئِنَا ۖ فَلَمَّا كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ تَوَلَّوْا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

**2:247** Teir palopit said to tem, “Yowbad has appointed Saul to be your king.” tasiyas said, “amawan kadilok towen hav kaleiwag over us, asinavin we nisesus singay worty op kaleiwag tan towen, e towen was nag given plenty op wealt?” towen said, “Yowbad has kosen towen over yakamiy, e has katamweis towen wa- sinap e statur.” Yowbad bestows his sovereignty upon whomever towen nanon. Yowbad ses embrasing e kakin.

وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ لَكُمْ طَالُوتَ مَلِكًۭا ۚ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ عَلَيْنَا وَنَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْمُلْكِ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ سَعَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمَالِ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَزَادَهُۥ بَسْطَةًۭ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ وَٱلْجِسْمِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤْتِى مُلْكَهُۥ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:248** E teir palopit said to tem, “ proop op his kingsip ses towen ark nanon be restored to yakamiy, bringing trankility prom your Guyaw, e reliks lept by pamily op Moses e pamily op Aaron. Kawegeis nanon be karried by takayob. Wa- towen ses mulin giyan yakamiy, kukin yakamiy nisesus believers.”

وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ ءَايَةَ مُلْكِهِۦٓ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلتَّابُوتُ فِيهِ سَكِينَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَبَقِيَّةٌۭ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ ءَالُ مُوسَىٰ وَءَالُ هَٰرُونَ تَحْمِلُهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**2:249** Asinavin Saul set out son troops, towen said, “Yowbad nanon be testing yakamiy son lay. Kal mom prom kawegeis vag nag belong son yeg. Ge kal vag nag mom prom kawegeis, vag belong son yeg, tage nag giyan kal skoops wanakaew kakit son his nim.” ge tasiyas drank prom kawegeis, tage nag giyan pew op tem. Mo, asinavin towen krossed kawegeis, towen e siyas am-towen kamiyeb son towen, tasiyas said, “we hav nag strengt to lal Goliath e his troops nagein.” ge siyas am-towen knew towen tasiyas would kalivet Yowbad said, “amawan babaw kakit group has depeated avakaein group by Yowbad nanon. Yowbad ses son steadpast.”

فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

**2:250** E asinavin tasiyas konpronted Goliath e his troops, tasiyas said, “our Guyaw, pour watinow patiens wakunuwatan us, e katimweis our pootold, e support us against paitless gamag.”

وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا۟ لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًۭا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

**2:251** E tasiyas depeated tem by Yowbad leav, e Deibid katimet Goliath, e Yowbad bo isek towen sovereignty e sinap, e taugt towen towen nanon. Wer kawegeis nag giyan Yowbad restraining gamag, musinis by gidukis op oters, pwepway would hav bo nein to ruin. Ge Yowbad ses grasious towards mankind.

فَهَزَمُوهُم بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُۥدُ جَالُوتَ وَءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُلْكَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَهُۥ مِمَّا يَشَآءُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍۢ لَّفَسَدَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**2:252** Yamwag nisesus Yowbad revelations, amata- we resit to yakamiy wa- kamounid. Yakamiy nisesus kweitan op takayob.

تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**2:253** Yamwag takayob: we bo isek musinis advantag over oters. To musinis op tem Yowbad wage direktly, e musinis towen raised wa- rank. We bo isek Yeisuw son op Meli gimagim mirakles, e we katimweis towen son bwanabwein kululuwan. Had Yowbad nanon, siyas am-towen sukseeded tem would nag hav pougt kweitan kweitan, apter gimagim mulin had am to tem; ge tasiyas disputed; musinis op tem kamiyeb, e musinis op tem yakaein. Had Yowbad nanon, tasiyas would nag hav pougt kweitan kweitan; ge Yowbad vag whatever towen met.

۞ تِلْكَ ٱلرُّسُلُ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۘ مِّنْهُم مَّن كَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَهُمْ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَيَّدْنَٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ ۗ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقْتَتَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ وَلَٰكِنِ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ ءَامَنَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن كَفَرَ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ

**2:254** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Gimwal prom what we hav given yakamiy, kweiboug yam am wa- amata- one ses neiter gimwal, nor priendsip, nor intersession. Disbelievers nisesus wrongdoers.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خُلَّةٌۭ وَلَا شَفَٰعَةٌۭ ۗ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

**2:255** Yowbad! One ses nag yowbad tage nag towen, mov, sustainer. Neiter slumber overtakes towen, nor kandakwek. To towen belongs everyting wa- libalab e everyting wakunuwatan pwepway. Am-towen ses towen towen kadilok intersed son towen tage nag son his tam? Towen kakin what ses kweiboug tem, e what ses kuyeim tem; e tasiyas kannot yous kweitan op his sinap, tage nag towen nanon. His tron ekstends over libalab e pwepway, e teir preservation vag nag burden towen. Towen ses avakaein aveiyov, avakaein.

ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**2:256** One sall be nag kompulsion wa- religion; kadilok ked has mlavag distinkt prom bol ked. Kal renounses kalbaleb e kamiyeb wa- Yowbad has yous avakaein trustworty handl; amata- vag nag kanop. Yowbad ses kataluteg e kakin.

لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

**2:257** Yowbad ses Guyaw op siyas am-towen kamiyeb; towen brings tem out op darkness e siw wanuwan gagab. Giyan siyas am-towen yakaein, teir guyawaw nisesus kalbaleb wakunuwatan; tasiyas bring tem out op gagab e siw wanuwan darkness — yamwag nisesus inmates op kov, wa- amata- tasiyas nanon abid bisigeg.

ٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّٰغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

**2:258** Hav yakamiy nag dik towen am-towen kamimen son Ebelam about his Guyaw, peinan Yowbad had given towen sovereignty? Ebelam said, “my Guyaw ses towen am-towen sek mwamovan e silawun kanig.” towen said, “i sek mwamovan e silawun kanig.” Ebelam said, “Yowbad brings kalas prom east, so bring kawegeis prom west,” so blaspemer was konpounded. Yowbad vag nag katimlakay wrongdoing gamag.

أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِى حَآجَّ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ فِى رَبِّهِۦٓ أَنْ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُلْكَ إِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ رَبِّىَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ قَالَ أَنَا۠ أُحْىِۦ وَأُمِيتُ ۖ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْتِى بِٱلشَّمْسِ مِنَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ فَأْتِ بِهَا مِنَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ فَبُهِتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

**2:259** Adok gig towen am-towen passed by ven kollapsed wakunuwatan kawegeis poundations. Towen said, “amawan kadilok Yowbad reviv towen apter kawegeis demis?” tereupon Yowbad silawun towen to kanig giyan lakatutan bweilim, e mo resurrekted towen. Towen said, “giyan amawan aveiyov hav yakamiy tarried?” towen said, “i hav tarried giyan yam, adok part op yam.” towen said, “nag. Yakamiy hav tarried giyan lakatutan bweilim. Mwana look wa- your kan e your mom — kawegeis has nag spoiled — e look wa- your donkey. We nanon bub yakamiy wonder giyan mankind. E look wa- toutun, amawan we arrang tem, e mo klot tem son viniyon.” so asinavin kawegeis bekam gimagim to towen, towen said, “i kakin towen Yowbad has tawtoun over babaw wuliyoug.”

أَوْ كَٱلَّذِى مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍۢ وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا قَالَ أَنَّىٰ يُحْىِۦ هَٰذِهِ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۖ فَأَمَاتَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِا۟ئَةَ عَامٍۢ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَ ۖ قَالَ لَبِثْتُ يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ ۖ قَالَ بَل لَّبِثْتَ مِا۟ئَةَ عَامٍۢ فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِكَ وَشَرَابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰ حِمَارِكَ وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْعِظَامِ كَيْفَ نُنشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوهَا لَحْمًۭا ۚ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُۥ قَالَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

**2:260** E asinavin Ebelam said, “my Guyaw, kamtel yeg amawan yakamiy sek mwamovan to kanig.” towen said, “hav yakamiy nag kamiyeb?” towen said, “yes, ge to put my ikuyak wa- eas.” towen said, “kew kweivas alen, e inklin tem to yourselp, mo kab- part wakunuwatan katanok katanok kaytet, mo dow to tem; e tasiyas nanon am rusing to yakamiy. E kakin towen Yowbad ses powerpul e wis.”

وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِى كَيْفَ تُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ قَالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِن ۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِى ۖ قَالَ فَخُذْ أَرْبَعَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَصُرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍۢ مِّنْهُنَّ جُزْءًۭا ثُمَّ ٱدْعُهُنَّ يَأْتِينَكَ سَعْيًۭا ۚ وَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

**2:261** Kabebay op siyas am-towen gimwal teir wealt wa- Yowbad ked ses towen op anagin towen produses seven spikes; wa- katanok katanok spik ses lakatutan anagin. Yowbad multiplies giyan kal towen nanon. Yowbad ses bounteous e kakin.

مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنۢبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِى كُلِّ سُنۢبُلَةٍۢ مِّا۟ئَةُ حَبَّةٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُضَٰعِفُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

**2:262** Siyas am-towen gimwal teir wealt wa- ked op Yowbad, e mo vag nag bukun wanakaew what tasiyas spent son reminders op teir generosity adok son insults, nanon hav teir anagin son teir Guyaw — tasiyas hav nag to goul, nor sall tasiyas griev.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُتْبِعُونَ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ مَنًّۭا وَلَآ أَذًۭى ۙ لَّهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

**2:263** Kind livan e porgiveness nisesus bwein tan muloul bukun by insults. Yowbad ses rik e klement.

۞ قَوْلٌۭ مَّعْرُوفٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ خَيْرٌۭ مِّن صَدَقَةٍۢ يَتْبَعُهَآ أَذًۭى ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَلِيمٌۭ

**2:264** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Vag nag nullipy your karitabl deeds son reminders e hurtpul livan, gig towen am-towen gimwal his wealt to be seen by gamag, e vag nag kamiyeb wa- Yowbad e last yam. His likeness ses towen op mamanas dakul kovered son dibwanoug: downpour way kawegeis, e yageivin kawegeis bar — tasiyas kunamatuw nag prom teir epports. Yowbad vag nag katimlakay yakaein gamag.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُبْطِلُوا۟ صَدَقَٰتِكُم بِٱلْمَنِّ وَٱلْأَذَىٰ كَٱلَّذِى يُنفِقُ مَالَهُۥ رِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ صَفْوَانٍ عَلَيْهِ تُرَابٌۭ فَأَصَابَهُۥ وَابِلٌۭ فَتَرَكَهُۥ صَلْدًۭا ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

**2:265** E kabebay op siyas am-towen gimwal teir wealt nev Yowbad approval, e to katimweis teir souls, ses towen op bag wakunuwatan hillsid. Kukin mouvit bwaw palls wakunuwatan kawegeis, kawegeis produs ses doubled; e kukin nag mouvit bwaw palls, mo dew ses deis. Yowbad ses kin op everyting yakamiy vag.

وَمَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ وَتَثْبِيتًۭا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةٍۭ بِرَبْوَةٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌۭ فَـَٔاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا ضِعْفَيْنِ فَإِن لَّمْ يُصِبْهَا وَابِلٌۭ فَطَلٌّۭ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**2:266** Would anyon op yakamiy gig to hav bag op palms e vines, under amata- lay latay — son babaw kinds op anagin wa- kawegeis giyan towen, e kweiboug anbweilim has strikken towen, e towen has gwey gamagal — mo tornado son kov batters kawegeis, e kawegeis burns watinow? Mamagin Yowbad bub gimagim mulin giyan yakamiy, so towen yakamiy may replekt.

أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌۭ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَابٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَأَصَابَهُ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَلَهُۥ ذُرِّيَّةٌۭ ضُعَفَآءُ فَأَصَابَهَآ إِعْصَارٌۭ فِيهِ نَارٌۭ فَٱحْتَرَقَتْ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ

**2:267** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Sek op bwein wuliyoug yakamiy hav earned, e prom what we hav prodused giyan yakamiy prom pwepway. E vag nag pikk inperior wuliyoug to sek move, asinavin yakamiy yourselves would nag tam kawegeis tage nag son mat kapet. E kakin towen Yowbad ses kadilok e praiseworty.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ وَمِمَّآ أَخْرَجْنَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَلَا تَيَمَّمُوا۟ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنْهُ تُنفِقُونَ وَلَسْتُم بِـَٔاخِذِيهِ إِلَّآ أَن تُغْمِضُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ

**2:268** Seitan katagik yakamiy poverty, e urges yakamiy to immorality; ge Yowbad katagik yakamiy porgiveness prom dimlen, e gras. Yowbad ses embrasing e kakin.

ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱلْفَقْرَ وَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعِدُكُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلًۭا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:269** Towen sek sinap to whomever towen nanon. Kal ses given sinap has been given mananan bwein. Ge naga tonen pays towen tage nag siyas son insigt.

يُؤْتِى ٱلْحِكْمَةَ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْتَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِىَ خَيْرًۭا كَثِيرًۭا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

**2:270** Whatever muloul yakamiy sek, adok pledg yakamiy pulpill, Yowbad kakin kawegeis. Wrongdoers hav nag helpers.

وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن نَّفَقَةٍ أَوْ نَذَرْتُم مِّن نَّذْرٍۢ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُهُۥ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ

**2:271** Kukin yakamiy sek muloul openly, towen ses bwein. Ge kukin yakamiy keep kawegeis sekret, e sek kawegeis to needy wa- privat, towen ses bwein giyan yakamiy. Kawegeis nanon aton giyan musinis op your misdeeds. Yowbad ses kognisant op what yakamiy vag.

إِن تُبْدُوا۟ ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِىَ ۖ وَإِن تُخْفُوهَا وَتُؤْتُوهَا ٱلْفُقَرَآءَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَيُكَفِّرُ عَنكُم مِّن سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

**2:272** Teir guidans ses nag your responsibility, ge Yowbad katimlakay kal towen nanon. Kweitan muloul yakamiy sek ses giyan your own bwein. Kweitan muloul yakamiy sek sall be giyan sak op Yowbad. Kweitan muloul yakamiy sek nanon be repaid to yakamiy wa- kalawt, e yakamiy nanon nag be bol.

۞ لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكَ هُدَىٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَلِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُونَ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ

**2:273** Kawegeis ses giyan poor; siyas am-towen nisesus restrained wa- ked op Yowbad, e unabl to kinwun wa- dibwanoug. Unawar would dik tem rik, due to teir dignity. Yakamiy nanon rekognis tem by teir peatures. Tasiyas vag nag gan prom gamag insistently. Whatever muloul yakamiy sek, Yowbad ses awar op kawegeis.

لِلْفُقَرَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُحْصِرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ضَرْبًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَحْسَبُهُمُ ٱلْجَاهِلُ أَغْنِيَآءَ مِنَ ٱلتَّعَفُّفِ تَعْرِفُهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔلُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ إِلْحَافًۭا ۗ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ

**2:274** Siyas am-towen gimwal teir wealt by boug e yam, privately e publikly, nanon kow teir anagin prom teir Guyaw. Tasiyas hav nag to goul, nor sall tasiyas griev.

ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

**2:275** Siyas am-towen swallow usury nanon nag kit, tage nag someon driven mad by Seitan's kabikon. Towen ses peinan tasiyas dibek, “kommers ses gig usury.” ge Yowbad has permitted kommers, e has wot usury. Kal, wakunuwatan kow advis prom his Guyaw, reprains, may keep his past earnings, e his didawag rests son Yowbad. Ge kal resumes — yamwag nisesus dwellers op kov, wherein tasiyas nanon abid bisigeg.

ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ ٱلَّذِى يَتَخَبَّطُهُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ مِنَ ٱلْمَسِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْبَيْعُ مِثْلُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۗ وَأَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَيْعَ وَحَرَّمَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۚ فَمَن جَآءَهُۥ مَوْعِظَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَٱنتَهَىٰ فَلَهُۥ مَا سَلَفَ وَأَمْرُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

**2:276** Yowbad kondemns usury, e towen blesses muloul. Yowbad vag nag pwakit kweitan sinpul ingrat.

يَمْحَقُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ وَيُرْبِى ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ

**2:277** Siyas am-towen kamiyeb, e vag bwein deeds, e nitoug regularly, e sek muloul — tasiyas nanon hav teir anagin son teir Guyaw; tasiyas nanon hav nag goul, nor sall tasiyas griev.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

**2:278** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Goul Yowbad, e porgo what remains op usury, kukin yakamiy nisesus believers.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَذَرُوا۟ مَا بَقِىَ مِنَ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**2:279** Kukin yakamiy vag nag, mo kew notis op naviy by Yowbad e his takayob. Ge kukin yakamiy repent, yakamiy may keep your kapital, neiter bol, nor being bol.

فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَأْذَنُوا۟ بِحَرْبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَإِن تُبْتُمْ فَلَكُمْ رُءُوسُ أَمْوَٰلِكُمْ لَا تَظْلِمُونَ وَلَا تُظْلَمُونَ

**2:280** Ge kukin towen ses wa- hardsip, mo deperment ee tut op eas. Ge to remit kawegeis muloul ses bwein giyan yakamiy, kukin yakamiy amav knew.

وَإِن كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍۢ فَنَظِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ مَيْسَرَةٍۢ ۚ وَأَن تَصَدَّقُوا۟ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

**2:281** E guard yourselves against yam asinavin yakamiy nanon be siwlayum to Yowbad; mo katanok katanok soul nanon be anagin pully giyan what kawegeis has earned, e tasiyas nanon nag be bol.

وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًۭا تُرْجَعُونَ فِيهِ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

**2:282** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Asinavin yakamiy inkur debt among yourselves giyan sertain period op tut, lel kawegeis watinow. E hav skrib lel wa- your presens, wa- babaw pairness. E let nag skrib kamdiwew to lel, Yowbad has taugt towen. So let towen lel, e let debtor diktat. E let towen goul Yowbad, his Guyaw, e diminis nag prom kawegeis. Ge kukin debtor ses mentally depisient, adok gwey, adok unabl to diktat, mo let his guardian diktat son honesty. E dow to witness akweiy tawaw prom among yakamiy. Kukin akweiy tawaw nisesus nag availabl, mo kweitan taw e akweiy nummwey whos testimony ses akseptabl to babaw — kukin kweitan op tem pails to nuw, oter would remind nawen. Witnesses must nag kamdiwew asinavin dow upon. E vag nag dik kawegeis singay trivial to lel watinow, wheter kakit adok avakaein, inkluding tut op repayment. Towen ses singay ekitabl son Yowbad, e stronger evidens, e singay likely to gidem doubt — tage nag wa- didawag op spot transaktion wanuwein yakamiy — mo one ses nag kavnek wakunuwatan yakamiy kukin yakamiy vag nag lel kawegeis watinow. E let one be witnesses whenever yakamiy konklud kontrakt, e let nag yableb be bo ivag to eiter skrib adok witness. Kukin yakamiy vag towen, kawegeis ses korruption wakunuwatan your part. E goul Yowbad. Yowbad kamtilakay yakamiy. Yowbad ses awar op everyting.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌۭ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةًۭ تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌۭ وَلَا شَهِيدٌۭ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:283** Kukin yakamiy nisesus wakunuwatan yourney, e kannot ban skrib, mo sekurity deposit sould be nim over. Ge kukin yakamiy namis kweitan kweitan, let truste pulpill his namis, e let towen goul Yowbad, his Guyaw. E vag nag konseal testimony. Kal konseals kawegeis ses sinner wa- ikuyak. Yowbad ses awar op what yakamiy vag.

۞ وَإِن كُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍۢ وَلَمْ تَجِدُوا۟ كَاتِبًۭا فَرِهَٰنٌۭ مَّقْبُوضَةٌۭ ۖ فَإِنْ أَمِنَ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًۭا فَلْيُؤَدِّ ٱلَّذِى ٱؤْتُمِنَ أَمَٰنَتَهُۥ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ ۗ وَلَا تَكْتُمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ ۚ وَمَن يَكْتُمْهَا فَإِنَّهُۥٓ ءَاثِمٌۭ قَلْبُهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ

**2:284** To Yowbad belongs everyting wa- libalab e pwepway. Wheter yakamiy kamtel what ses wanuwan your selves, adok konseal kawegeis, Yowbad nanon dow yakamiy to akkount giyan kawegeis. Towen porgives kal towen nanon, e towen punises kal towen nanon. Yowbad ses kadilok to vag babaw wuliyoug.

لِّلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِن تُبْدُوا۟ مَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

**2:285** Takayob has kamiyeb wa- what was kamtel to towen prom his Guyaw, bo ivag believers. Tasiyas babaw hav kamiyeb wa- Yowbad, e his takayob, e his skriptures, e his takayob: “we bub nag distinktion wanuwein kweitan op his takayob.” e tasiyas dibek, “we kataluteg e we kablaway. Your porgiveness, our Guyaw. To yakamiy ses destiny.”

ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**2:286** Yowbad vag nag burden kweitan soul beyond kawegeis kapasity. To kawegeis kredit ses what kawegeis earns, e against kawegeis ses what kawegeis kommits. “our Guyaw, vag nag kondemn us kukin we numlev adok bub mistak. Our Guyaw, vag nag burden us yakamiy hav burdened siyas kweiboug us. Our Guyaw, vag nag burden us son singay tan we hav strengt to bear; e pardon us, e porgiv us, e hav nok nuwan wakunuwatan us. Yakamiy nisesus our Guyaw e Guyaw, so lab us against yakaein gamag.”

لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

---

## 3. Aal-Imran

**آلِ عِمْرَان** · Aal-Imran · Madina waseg · 200 ayat

*Pamily op Imran, birt op Meli, e dow to yous nuwanaw sisiyas to balawn op Yowbad.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Yowbad yagan waseg, Siwyoub, Nok Nuwan*

**3:1** Alip, lam, meem.

الٓمٓ

**3:2** Yowbad, one ses nag yowbad ge towen, mov, eternal.

ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ

**3:3** Towen sent watinow to yakamiy buk son kamounid, konpirming what neim kweiboug kawegeis; e towen sent watinow torah e gospel.

نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ

**3:4** Aporetim, guidans giyan mankind; e towen sent watinow kriterion. Siyas am-towen hav peiyaw Yowbad mulin nanon hav singay avakaein punisment. Yowbad ses migty, kadilok to kew reveng.

مِن قَبْلُ هُدًۭى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ

**3:5** Nag ses hidden prom Yowbad, wakunuwatan pwepway adok wa- libalab.

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ

**3:6** Kawegeis ses towen am-towen porms yakamiy wa- sinvanun towen nanon. One ses nag yowbad tage nag towen, almigty, wis.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**3:7** Kawegeis ses towen am-towen kamtel to yakamiy buk. Musinis op kawegeis verses nisesus depinitiv; tasiyas nisesus poundation op buk, e oters nisesus unspesipik. Giyan siyas wa- whos ikuyak ses deviation, tasiyas bukun unspesipik part, nev dessent, e nev to deriv interpretation. Ge naga tonen kakin kawegeis interpretation tage nag Yowbad e siyas pirmly gidawal wa- sinap dibek, “we kamiyeb wa- kawegeis; babaw ses prom our Guyaw.” ge naga tonen rekollekts tage nag siyas son sinap.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَٰتٌۭ مُّحْكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٌۭ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌۭ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّۭ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

**3:8** “Our Guyaw, vag nag silawun our ikuyak to swerv apter yakamiy hav katimlakay us, e bestow wakunuwatan us nok nuwan prom your presens; yakamiy nisesus giver.”

رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

**3:9** “Our Guyaw, yakamiy nanon katakunouk gamag giyan yam wa- amata- one ses nag doubt.” Yowbad nanon nag kweitan tut kanop his katagik.

رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ

**3:10** Giyan siyas am-towen yakaein, neiter teir wealt nor teir gamagal nanon avail tem anyting against Yowbad. Yamwag nanon be puel giyan kov.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ

**3:11** Gig behavior op Pharaoh's gamag e siyas kweiboug tem. Tasiyas peiyaw our mulin, so Yowbad yous tem giyan teir sins. Yowbad ses strikt wa- retribution.

كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

**3:12** Dibek to siyas am-towen yakaein, “yakamiy nanon be depeated, e rounded wanakaew siw wanuwan wadiginasim — awpul resting-kab-.”

قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

**3:13** One was mulin giyan yakamiy wa- akweiy sagal towen met. Kweitan sagal kanaviy wa- ked op Yowbad, e oter was yakaein. Tasiyas kin tem son teir own mat twis teir number. Ge Yowbad supports son his lab whomever towen nanon. Wa- towen ses lesson giyan siyas son insigt.

قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌۭ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا ۖ فِئَةٌۭ تُقَٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌۭ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ

**3:14** Adorned giyan gamag ses pwakit op met, suk nummwey, e gamagal, e piles upon piles op goul e silib, e branded hos, e livestokk, e pields. Yamwag nisesus konvenienses op worldly mwamovan, ge son Yowbad yaweid pinest resort.

زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ

**3:15** Dibek, “sall i dibek yakamiy op kweitan youd bwein tan towen? Giyan siyas am-towen nisesus rigteous, son teir Guyaw nisesus bag sukwawl amata- lay latay, ama- tasiyas nanon remain bisigeg, e puripied spouses, e akseptans prom Yowbad.” Yowbad ses observant op servants.

۞ قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزْوَٰجٌۭ مُّطَهَّرَةٌۭ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

**3:16** Siyas am-towen dibek, “our Guyaw, we hav kamiyeb, so porgiv us our sins, e katimov us prom gidaged won op kov.”

ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ

**3:17** Kapatul, e trutpul, e reverent, e karitabl, e seekers op porgiveness wa- lalayis.

ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ

**3:18** Yowbad bears witness towen one ses nag yowbad ge towen, vag takayob, e siyas endowed son sinap — upolding yustis. One ses nag yowbad ge towen, migty, wis.

شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**3:19** Religion son Yowbad ses islam. Siyas to kal skriptur was given dippered amav apter sinap neim to tem, out op envy among tatineis. Kal peiyaw mulin op Yowbad — Yowbad ses kikk to kew akkount.

إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

**3:20** Kukin tasiyas kamimen son yakamiy, dibek, “i hav surrendered myselp to Yowbad, e siyas am-towen bukun yeg.” e dibek to siyas am-towen wer given skriptur, e to unlearned, “hav yakamiy surrendered?” kukin tasiyas hav surrendered, mo tasiyas nisesus katimlakay; ge kukin tasiyas kanavin move, mo your duty ses to konvey. Yowbad ses kin op servants.

فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ ۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّۦنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ ۚ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

**3:21** Giyan siyas am-towen depy Yowbad revelations, e katimet palopit unyustly, e katimet siyas am-towen advokat yustis among gamag — katagik tem mamayuy retribution.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّۢ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

**3:22** Tasiyas nisesus siyas whos deeds nanon am to nag, wa- towen ven watinow e wa- hereapter; e tasiyas nanon hav nag saviors.

أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

**3:23** Hav yakamiy nag dik siyas am-towen wer given kaluweg op skriptur, tasiyas wer dow to skriptur op Yowbad to arbitrat wanuwein tem; mo musinis op tem kanavin kuyeim, e deklined?

أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

**3:24** Towen ses peinan tasiyas said, “ kov nanon nag kabikon us tage nag giyan limited number op yam.” tasiyas hav been misled wa- teir religion by yaweid tasiyas pabrikated.

ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍۢ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

**3:25** Amawan about asinavin we katakunouk tem giyan yam wa- amata- one ses nag doubt, e katanok katanok soul nanon be paid wa- kalawt giyan what kawegeis has earned, e tasiyas nanon nag be bol?

فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

**3:26** Dibek, “o Yowbad, tanuwagan op sovereignty. Yakamiy grant sovereignty to kal yakamiy nanon, e yakamiy strip sovereignty prom kal yakamiy nanon. Yakamiy honor kal yakamiy nanon, e yakamiy humiliat kal yakamiy nanon. Wa- your nim ses babaw goodness. Yakamiy nisesus kapabl op babaw wuliyoug.”

قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

**3:27** “Yakamiy merg boug siw wanuwan yam, e yakamiy merg yam siw wanuwan boug; e yakamiy bring mov out op kanig, e yakamiy bring kanig out op mov; e yakamiy provid giyan kal yakamiy nanon witout takwen.”

تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

**3:28** Believers nisesus nag to kew disbelievers giyan veiyon instead op believers. Kal vag towen has nag to vag son Yowbad, unless kawegeis ses to protekt your own selves against tem. Yowbad katiboug nuwan yakamiy to bewar op towen. To Yowbad ses destiny.

لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةًۭ ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**3:29** Dibek, “wheter yakamiy konseal what ses wa- your ikuyak, adok disklos kawegeis, Yowbad kakin kawegeis.” towen kakin everyting wa- libalab e pwepway. Yowbad ses powerpul over everyting.

قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ

**3:30** Wakunuwatan yam asinavin katanok katanok soul ban babaw bwein kawegeis has bo ivag presented. E giyan kalbaleb kawegeis has bo ivag, kawegeis nanon sivinan one wer avakaein distans wanuwein tem. Yowbad kautions yakamiy op dimlen. Yowbad ses kind towards servants.

يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ مُّحْضَرًۭا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًۭا ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

**3:31** Dibek, “kukin yakamiy pwakit Yowbad, mo bukun yeg, e Yowbad nanon pwakit yakamiy, e nanon porgiv yakamiy your sins.” Yowbad ses porgiving e nok nuwan.

قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

**3:32** Dibek, “kablaway Yowbad e takayob.” ge kukin tasiyas kanavin move — Yowbad vag nag pwakit paitless.

قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

**3:33** Yowbad kos Adam, e Noah, e pamily op Ebelam, e pamily op Imran, over babaw mankind.

۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحًۭا وَءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمْرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**3:34** Natug kweitan op oter. Yowbad ses hearer e knower.

ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

**3:35** Kwav op Imran said, “my Guyaw, i hav vowed to yakamiy what ses wa- my sinvanun, dedikated, so tam prom yeg; yakamiy nisesus hearer e knower.”

إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**3:36** E asinavin manawen delivered nawen, manawen said, “my Guyaw, i hav delivered pemal,” e Yowbad was bwein awar op what manawen has delivered, “e mal ses nag gig pemal, e i hav yagan nawen Meli, e hav kommended nawen e nawen dessendants to your protektion, prom Seitan outkast.”

فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ

**3:37** Nawen Guyaw tam nawen son grasious reseption, e brougt nawen beautipul upbringing, e entrusted nawen to kar op Zechariah. Whenever Zechariah siw upon nawen wa- sanktuary, towen ban nawen son provision. Towen said, “o Meli, ama- bo ivag yakamiy get towen prom?” manawen said, “kawegeis ses prom Yowbad; Yowbad provides to kal towen nanon witout rekkoning.”

فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

**3:38** Tereupon Zechariah nitoug to his Guyaw; towen said, “my Guyaw, bestow wakunuwatan yeg bwein natug prom your presens; yakamiy nisesus hearer op prayers.”

هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةًۭ طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ

**3:39** Mo takayob dow out to towen, towen stood nitoug wa- sanktuary: “Yowbad sek yakamiy bwein bulagan op Yon; konpirming livan prom Yowbad, e honorabl, e moral, e palopit; kweitan op didumwal.”

فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌۭ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًۭا وَحَصُورًۭا وَنَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

**3:40** Towen said, “my Guyaw, amawan nanon i hav son, asinavin kweiboug anbweilim has overtaken yeg, e my kwav ses barren?” towen said, “kadilok so, Yowbad vag whatever towen nanon.”

قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ

**3:41** Towen said, “my Guyaw, sek yeg mulin.” towen said, “your mulin ses towen yakamiy sall nag kawsiyeg to gamag giyan kweitoun yam, tage nag by gestures. E nuw your Guyaw mananan, e kamumwan wa- kwayav e gaboug.”

قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًۭا ۗ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًۭا وَسَبِّحْ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَٰرِ

**3:42** Takayob said, “o Meli, Yowbad has kosen yakamiy, e has puripied yakamiy. Towen has kosen yakamiy over babaw nummwey op ven watinow.

وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**3:43** “O Meli, be devoted to your Guyaw, e bow watinow, e kneel son siyas am-towen kneel.”

يَٰمَرْيَمُ ٱقْنُتِى لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ

**3:44** Yamwag nisesus akkounts prom unseen, amata- we kamtel to yakamiy. Yakamiy wer nag son tem asinavin tasiyas kast teir babaw to amata- op tem would kew karg op Meli; nor wer yakamiy son tem tasiyas karreled.

ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

**3:45** Takayob said, “o Meli, Yowbad sek yakamiy bwein bulagan op livan prom towen. His yagan ses Kelis, Yeisuw, son op Meli, bwein-esteemed wa- towen ven watinow e nekst, e kweitan op nearest.

إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ ٱسْمُهُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًۭا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

**3:46** Towen nanon kawsiyeg to gamag prom krib, e wa- adultood, e nanon be kweitan op rigteous.”

وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

**3:47** Manawen said, “my Guyaw, amawan kadilok i hav gwad, asinavin nag taw has kabikon yeg?” towen said, “kawegeis nanon be so. Yowbad bub whatever towen nanon. To hav anyting bo ivag, towen amav dibek to kawegeis, ‘be,' e kawegeis ses.”

قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

**3:48** E towen nanon kamtilakay towen skriptur e sinap, e torah e gospel.

وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ

**3:49** Takayob to gamagal op Yisleil: “i hav am to yakamiy son mulin prom your Guyaw. I bub giyan yakamiy out op bidapwat pigur op alen; mo i breat siw wanuwan kawegeis, e kawegeis mlavag alen by Yowbad leav. E i heal kaguligwal e leprous, e i reviv kanig, by Yowbad leav. E i dibek yakamiy konserning what yakamiy kam, e what yakamiy stor wa- your ven. Wa- towen ses mulin giyan yakamiy, kukin yakamiy nisesus believers.”

وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

**3:50** “E veripying what yaweid kweiboug yeg op torah, e to bub lawpul giyan yakamiy musinis op what was wot to yakamiy. I hav am to yakamiy son mulin prom your Guyaw; so goul Yowbad, e kablaway yeg.”

وَمُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَجِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

**3:51** “Yowbad ses my Guyaw e your Guyaw, so yakawn towen. Towen ses damoms ked.”

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۗ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

**3:52** Asinavin Yeisuw nanon disbeliep wakunuwatan teir part, towen said, “am-towen nisesus my allies towards Yowbad?” dissiples said, “we nisesus Yowbad allies; we hav kamiyeb wa- Yowbad, e bear witness towen we tam.”

۞ فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ

**3:53** “Our Guyaw, we hav kamiyeb wa- what yakamiy hav kamtel, e we hav bukun takayob, so vin us among witnesses.”

رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

**3:54** Tasiyas planned, e Yowbad planned; ge Yowbad ses bwein singay op planners.

وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَٰكِرِينَ

**3:55** Yowbad said, “o Yeisuw, i am terminating your mwamovan, e raising yakamiy to yeg, e gimagim yakamiy op siyas am-towen yakaein. E i nanon bub siyas am-towen bukun yakamiy superior to siyas am-towen yakaein, ee yam op resurrektion. Mo to yeg ses your siwlayum; mo i nanon kaleiwag wanuwein yakamiy regarding what yakamiy wer disputing.

إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّى مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

**3:56** Giyan siyas am-towen yakaein, i nanon punis tem son singay avakaein punisment, wa- towen ven watinow e nekst, e tasiyas nanon hav nag helpers.

فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

**3:57** E giyan siyas am-towen kamiyeb e vag bwein wotet, towen nanon sek tem teir anagin wa- kalawt. Yowbad vag nag pwakit unyust.”

وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

**3:58** Towen ses what we resit to yakamiy op verses e wis reminder.

ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**3:59** Likeness op Yeisuw wa- Yowbad sigt ses towen op Adam: towen bub towen prom musamus, mo said to towen, “be,” e towen was.

إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ ۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

**3:60** Kamounid ses prom your Guyaw, so vag nag be op siyas am-towen doubt.

ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ

**3:61** E kukin anyon disputes son yakamiy about towen, apter sinap towen has am to yakamiy, dibek, “am, let us dow our gamagal e your gamagal, e our nummwey e your nummwey, e ourselves e yourselves, e let us invok Yowbad bulet wakunuwatan liars.”

فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ

**3:62** Towen ses narrativ op kamounid: one ses nag yowbad ge Yowbad. Yowbad ses migty, wis.

إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْقَصَصُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

**3:63** Ge kukin tasiyas kanavin move — Yowbad kakin korrupt.

فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

**3:64** Dibek, “o gamag op buk, am to terms kommon wanuwein us e yakamiy: towen we yakawn naga tonen ge Yowbad, e towen we assosiat nag son towen, e towen naga tonen op us kew oters guyawaw dadan Yowbad.” e kukin tasiyas kanavin move, dibek, “bear witness towen we hav submitted.”

قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍۢ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًۭا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ

**3:65** O gamag op buk! Why vag yakamiy kamimen about Ebelam, asinavin torah e gospel wer nag kamtel ee apter towen? Nanon yakamiy nag silawun?

يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

**3:66** Keikay yakamiy nisesus — yakamiy kamimen about wuliyoug yakamiy kakin, ge why vag yakamiy kamimen about wuliyoug yakamiy vag nag kakin? Yowbad kakin, e yakamiy vag nag kakin.

هَٰٓأَنتُمْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

**3:67** Ebelam was neiter yew nor kristian, ge towen was monoteist, muslim. E towen was nag op polyteists.

مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّۭا وَلَٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًۭا مُّسْلِمًۭا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

**3:68** Gamag avakaein deserving op Ebelam nisesus siyas am-towen bukun towen, e towen palopit, e siyas am-towen kamiyeb. Yowbad ses guardian op believers.

إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

**3:69** Sagal op gamag op buk would pwakit to mgwey yakamiy astray, ge tasiyas amav mgwey tatineis astray, e tasiyas vag nag realis kawegeis.

وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ

**3:70** O gamag op buk! Why vag yakamiy peiyaw revelations op Yowbad, kadilok yakamiy witness?

يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ

**3:71** O gamag op buk! Why vag yakamiy konpound kamounid son palsehood, e knowingly konseal kamounid?

يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

**3:72** Musinis op gamag op buk dibek, “kamiyeb wa- what was kamtel to believers wa- silamaw op yam, e peiyaw kawegeis wa- kawegeis end, so towen tasiyas may siwlayum.”

وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

**3:73** E namis naga tonen tage nag siyas am-towen bukun your religion.” dibek, “guidans ses Yowbad guidans. Kukin someon ses given gig op what yakamiy wer given, adok tasiyas kamimen son yakamiy kweiboug your Guyaw, dibek, “babaw gras ses wa- Yowbad nim; towen sek kawegeis to whomever towen nanon.” Yowbad ses bounteous e kakin.

وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْهُدَىٰ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ أَن يُؤْتَىٰٓ أَحَدٌۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَآجُّوكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

**3:74** Towen spesipies his nok nuwan giyan whomever towen nanon. Yowbad ses possessor op sublim gras.

يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

**3:75** Among gamag op buk ses towen, am-towen, kukin yakamiy entrust towen son heap op goul, towen nanon sek kawegeis kuyeim to yakamiy. E among tem ses towen, am-towen, kukin yakamiy entrust towen son katanok koin, towen nanon nag sek kawegeis kuyeim to yakamiy, unless yakamiy keep apter towen. Towen ses peinan tasiyas dibek, “we nisesus under nag obligation towards gentiles.” tasiyas dibek yaweid about Yowbad, e tasiyas kakin kawegeis.

۞ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍۢ يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍۢ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَآئِمًۭا ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّۦنَ سَبِيلٌۭ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

**3:76** Bo, kal pulpills his kommitments e maintains piety — Yowbad pwakit pious.

بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِۦ وَٱتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

**3:77** Siyas am-towen ekskang kovenant op Yowbad, e teir vows, giyan kakit mapun, nanon hav nag kaluweg wa- hereapter, e Yowbad nanon nag kawsiyeg to tem, nor nanon towen look wa- tem wakunuwatan yam op resurrektion, nor nanon towen puripy tem. Tasiyas nanon hav mamayuy punisment.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَٰقَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

**3:78** E among tem nisesus siyas am-towen twist skriptur son teir mayen, towen yakamiy may dik kawegeis prom skriptur, asinavin kawegeis ses nag prom skriptur. E tasiyas dibek, “kawegeis ses prom Yowbad,” asinavin kawegeis ses nag prom Yowbad. Tasiyas dibek yaweid e attribut tem to Yowbad, knowingly.

وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقًۭا يَلْوُۥنَ أَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

**3:79** Nag gamag to kal Yowbad has given skriptur, e sinap, e propetood would ever dibek to gamag, “be my worsipers rater tan Yowbad.” rater, “be gamag op Guyaw, akkording to skriptur yakamiy kamtilakay, e teakings yakamiy sinop.”

مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤْتِيَهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ كُونُوا۟ عِبَادًۭا لِّى مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَٰكِن كُونُوا۟ رَبَّٰنِيِّۦنَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَدْرُسُونَ

**3:80** Nor would towen kommand yakamiy to kew takayob e palopit guyawaw. Would towen kommand yakamiy to inpidelity apter yakamiy hav submitted?

وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ أَرْبَابًا ۗ أَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

**3:81** Yowbad kow kovenant op palopit, “inasmuk i hav given yakamiy op skriptur e sinap; sould takayob am to yakamiy veripying what yakamiy hav, yakamiy sall kamiyeb wa- towen, e support towen.” towen said, “vag yakamiy appirm my kovenant e kew kawegeis upon yourselves?” tasiyas said, “we appirm kawegeis.” towen said, “mo bear witness, e i am son yakamiy among witnesses.”

وَإِذْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَٰقَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ لَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُكُم مِّن كِتَٰبٍۢ وَحِكْمَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّصَدِّقٌۭ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِۦ وَلَتَنصُرُنَّهُۥ ۚ قَالَ ءَأَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَخَذْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُمْ إِصْرِى ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَقْرَرْنَا ۚ قَالَ فَٱشْهَدُوا۟ وَأَنَا۠ مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

**3:82** Kal kanavin move apter towen — yamwag nisesus deseitpul.

فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

**3:83** Vag tasiyas met oter tan religion op Yowbad, asinavin to towen has submitted everyting wa- libalab e pwepway, willingly adok unwillingly, e to towen tasiyas nanon be siwlayum?

أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ وَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلَمَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًۭا وَكَرْهًۭا وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ

**3:84** Dibek, “we kamiyeb wa- Yowbad, e wa- what was kamtel to us; e wa- what was kamtel to Ebelam, e Ishmael, e Aysak, e Jacob, e patriarks; e wa- what was given to Moses, e Yeisuw, e palopit prom teir Guyaw. We bub nag distinktion wanuwein kweitan op tem, e to towen we tam.”

قُلْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ

**3:85** Kal nev oter tan islam religion, kawegeis nanon nag be tam prom towen, e wa- hereapter towen nanon be among losers.

وَمَن يَبْتَغِ غَيْرَ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمِ دِينًۭا فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ

**3:86** Amawan nanon Yowbad katimlakay gamag am-towen yakaein apter having kamiyeb, e had witnessed towen takayob ses magene, e gimagim proops had am to tem? Yowbad vag nag katimlakay unyust gamag.

كَيْفَ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ قَوْمًۭا كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ وَشَهِدُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلرَّسُولَ حَقٌّۭ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

**3:87** Siyas — teir penalty ses towen upon tem palls bulet op Yowbad, e op takayob, e op babaw mankind.

أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ

**3:88** Remaining wa- kawegeis eternally, witout teir punisment being eased prom tem, e witout being reprieved.

خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

**3:89** Tage nag siyas am-towen repent apterwards, e reporm; giyan Yowbad ses porgiving e nok nuwan.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

**3:90** Giyan siyas am-towen yakaein apter having kamiyeb, mo plung deeper siw wanuwan disbeliep, teir repentans nanon nag be tam; yamwag nisesus kanig.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ ثُمَّ ٱزْدَادُوا۟ كُفْرًۭا لَّن تُقْبَلَ تَوْبَتُهُمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

**3:91** Giyan siyas am-towen yakaein e kanig disbelievers, kadilok pwepway kalawt op goul would nag be tam prom kweitan op tem, wer towen to opper kawegeis giyan ransom. Yamwag nanon hav mamayuy torment, e nanon hav nag saviors.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌۭ فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِم مِّلْءُ ٱلْأَرْضِ ذَهَبًۭا وَلَوِ ٱفْتَدَىٰ بِهِۦٓ ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

**3:92** Yakamiy nanon nag attain virtuous kondukt ee yakamiy sek op what yakamiy keris. Whatever yakamiy sek move, Yowbad ses awar op kawegeis.

لَن تَنَالُوا۟ ٱلْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌۭ

**3:93** Babaw kan was permissibl to gamagal op Yisleil, tage nag what Yisleil porbad giyan itselp kweiboug torah was kamtel. Dibek, “bring torah, e vin kawegeis, kukin yakamiy nisesus trutpul.”

۞ كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ ۗ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ فَٱتْلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

**3:94** Kal porges yaweid about Yowbad apter towen — yamwag nisesus unyust.

فَمَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

**3:95** Dibek, “Yowbad has spoken kamounid, so bukun religion op Ebelam monoteist; towen was nag pagan.”

قُلْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ فَٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًۭا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

**3:96** Gin- pak establised giyan mankind ses kweitan wa- bekka; blessed, e guidans giyan babaw gamag.

إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍۢ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِى بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكًۭا وَهُدًۭى لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**3:97** Wa- kawegeis nisesus evident mulin; station op Ebelam. Kal siw kawegeis attains sekurity. Pilgrimag to pak ses duty to Yowbad giyan babaw am-towen kadilok bub yourney. Ge giyan siyas am-towen kamdiwew — Yowbad ses independent op ven watinow.

فِيهِ ءَايَٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَٰتٌۭ مَّقَامُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُۥ كَانَ ءَامِنًۭا ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ حِجُّ ٱلْبَيْتِ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًۭا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**3:98** Dibek, “o gamag op skriptur, why vag yakamiy peiyaw revelations op Yowbad, asinavin Yowbad witnesses what yakamiy vag?”

قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا تَعْمَلُونَ

**3:99** Dibek, “o gamag op skriptur, why vag yakamiy kabiyun prom Yowbad ked siyas am-towen kamiyeb, nev to distort kawegeis, kadilok toug yakamiy nisesus witnesses? Yowbad ses nag unawar op what yakamiy vag.”

قُلْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ تَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًۭا وَأَنتُمْ شُهَدَآءُ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

**3:100** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Kukin yakamiy kablaway sagal op siyas am-towen wer given skriptur, tasiyas nanon kanavin yakamiy, apter your beliep, siw wanuwan disbelievers.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ فَرِيقًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعْدَ إِيمَٰنِكُمْ كَٰفِرِينَ

**3:101** E amawan kould yakamiy yakaein, asinavin Yowbad revelations nisesus being resited to yakamiy, e among yakamiy ses his takayob? Kal kleaves to Yowbad has been katimlakay to damoms ked.

وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ وَأَنتُمْ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ وَفِيكُمْ رَسُولُهُۥ ۗ وَمَن يَعْتَصِم بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ هُدِىَ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

**3:102** O yakamiy am-towen kamiyeb! Rever Yowbad son due reverens, e vag nag kanig tage nag muslims.

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِۦ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

**3:103** E yous nuwanaw to balawn op Yowbad, altogeter, e vag nag mlavag kaluweg.
