## 37. As-Saffat

**ٱلصَّافَّات** · As-Saffat · Meka waseg · 182 ayat

*Siyas ranked wa- kolumns: selestial prosession, e kwaneib op Ebelam e sakripis.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Yowbad yagan waseg, Siwyoub, Nok Nuwan*

**37:1** By aligners aligning.

وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا

**37:2** E drivers driving.

فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا

**37:3** E resiters op reminder.

فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا

**37:4** Your Yowbad ses bo kweitan.

إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ

**37:5** Guyaw op libalab e pwepway, e everyting wanuwein tem; e Guyaw op easts.

رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ

**37:6** We hav adorned lower libalab son beauty op planets.

إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ

**37:7** E guarded kawegeis against katanok katanok depiant devil.

وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ

**37:8** Tasiyas kannot eavesdrop wakunuwatan supernal elit, giyan tasiyas get bombarded prom katanok katanok valam.

لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ

**37:9** Repelled — tasiyas nanon hav lingering torment.

دُحُورًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ

**37:10** Tage nag giyan towen am-towen snatkes pragment — towen gets pursued by piersing proyektil.

إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ

**37:11** Inkir op tem, “nisesus tasiyas singay kakagag to bub, adok oters we bub?” we bub tem prom stikky bidapwat.

فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ

**37:12** Ge yakamiy wonder, e tasiyas gin.

بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ

**37:13** E asinavin reminded, tasiyas pay nag attention.

وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ

**37:14** E asinavin tasiyas kin mulin, tasiyas gin.

وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ

**37:15** E tasiyas dibek, “towen ses nag ge bidakwab magik.

وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

**37:16** Asinavin we hav kanig e mlavag musamus e toutun, sall we be resurrekted?

أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

**37:17** E our tabun op kweiboug?”

أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

**37:18** Dibek, “yes bo, e yakamiy nanon be totally subdued.”

قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

**37:19** Kawegeis nanon be katanok nudg, e tasiyas nanon be utun.

فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

**37:20** Tasiyas nanon dibek, “woe to us. Towen ses yam op yudgment.”

وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

**37:21** “Towen ses yam op separation amata- yakamiy used to kayan.

هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

**37:22** Katakunouk siyas am-towen bo ivag bol, e teir mates, e what tasiyas used to yakawn.

۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

**37:23** Dadan Yowbad, e mgwey tem to ked to wadiginasim.

مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:24** E stop tem. Tasiyas nisesus to be gan.”

وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ

**37:25** What ses matter son yakamiy? Why vag yakamiy nag lab kweitan kweitan?

مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

**37:26** Wa- livan, wakunuwatan towen yam, tasiyas nanon be submissiv.

بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ

**37:27** Tasiyas nanon am to kweitan kweitan, gan kweitan kweitan.

وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**37:28** Tasiyas nanon dibek, “yakamiy used to am wa- us prom kadilok.”

قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

**37:29** Tasiyas nanon dibek, “yakamiy yourselves wer nag believers.

قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

**37:30** We had nag kaleiwag over yakamiy. Yakamiy yourselves wer rebellious gamag.

وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ

**37:31** Livan op our Guyaw has been realised against us. We nisesus amnan kawegeis.

فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

**37:32** We sedused yakamiy. We wer sedusers.”

فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ

**37:33** Wakunuwatan towen yam, tasiyas nanon kaluweg wa- punisment.

فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

**37:34** Mamagin we deal son sinners.

إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

**37:35** Asinavin kawegeis was said to tem, “one ses nag yowbad tage nag Yowbad,” tasiyas grew arrogant.

إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

**37:36** E said, “nisesus we to piyev our yowbad giyan mad poet?”

وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

**37:37** Wa- livan, towen neim son kamounid, e towen konpirmed takayob.

بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:38** Avakaein assuredly, yakamiy nanon amnan mamayuy punisment.

إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ

**37:39** E yakamiy nanon be repaid amav giyan what yakamiy used to vag.

وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

**37:40** Tage nag giyan Yowbad sinser servants.

إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**37:41** Giyan tem ses known provision.

أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

**37:42** Anagin; e tasiyas nanon be honored.

فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ

**37:43** Wa- bag op bliss.

فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

**37:44** Wakunuwatan purnisings, lal kweitan kweitan.

عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

**37:45** Tasiyas nanon be oppered kwavig op bwein mom.

يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ

**37:46** Whit; deligt to siyas am-towen mom.

بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ

**37:47** Nag kweitan tut polluted, e nag kweitan tut intoksikating.

لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

**37:48** Son tem nanon be baspul nummwey son lovely mat.

وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌۭ

**37:49** Kukin tasiyas wer klosely guarded pearls.

كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ

**37:50** Mo tasiyas nanon approak kweitan kweitan, gan.

فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

**37:51** Kweitan op tem nanon dibek, “i used to hav veiyon.

قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ

**37:52** Am-towen used to dibek, “nisesus yakamiy op siyas am-towen kamiyeb?

يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ

**37:53** Towen apter we kanig e mlavag musamus e toutun, we nanon be dow to akkount?”

أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

**37:54** Towen nanon dibek, “nanon yakamiy hav look?”

قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

**37:55** Towen nanon look, e nanon kin towen wa- pit op wadiginasim.

فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:56** Towen nanon dibek, “by Yowbad, yakamiy kakita ruined yeg.

قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ

**37:57** Wer kawegeis nag giyan gras op my Guyaw, i would hav been among arraigned.”

وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

**37:58** “We nanon nag kanig.

أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

**37:59** Tage nag giyan our gin- kanig, e we nanon nag be punised.”

إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

**37:60** Towen ses suprem triump.

إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

**37:61** Giyan gig op towen let workers wotet.

لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ

**37:62** Ses towen bwein hospitality, adok amweilok op bitterness?

أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

**37:63** We mad kawegeis ordeal giyan unyust.

إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ

**37:64** Kawegeis ses amweilok towen katimweis prom pwan op wadiginasim.

إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

**37:65** Kawegeis anagin nisesus gig devils' daban.

طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

**37:66** Tasiyas nanon kam prom kawegeis, e pill teir bellies son kawegeis.

لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

**37:169** We would hav been Yowbad paitpul servants.”

لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**37:170** Ge tasiyas peiyaw kawegeis, so tasiyas nanon ban out.

فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

**37:171** Our livan has nanawan bo nein out to our servant takayob.

وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:172** Kawegeis ses tasiyas am-towen nanon be supported.

إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ

**37:173** E our troops nanon be viktors.

وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ

**37:174** So disregard tem giyan whil.

فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

**37:175** E kakin tem — tasiyas nanon soon kin.

وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

**37:176** Nisesus tasiyas nev to hasten our punisment?

أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

**37:177** Asinavin kawegeis bus siw wanuwan teir yard, miserabl nanon be gaboug op siyas porewarned.

فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

**37:178** So avoid tem giyan whil.

وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

**37:179** E kakin — tasiyas nanon soon kin.

وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

**37:180** Eksalted be your Guyaw, Guyaw op yakawn, beyond teir allegations.

سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

**37:181** E niwal be upon takayob.

وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

**37:182** E kamumwan be to Yowbad, Guyaw op ven watinow.

وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

## 38. Sad

**ص** · Sad · Meka waseg · 88 ayat

*Sad: Deibid kaleiwag, Solomon gratepul, e reminder nag to bukun siyas am-towen stray.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Yowbad yagan waseg, Siwyoub, Nok Nuwan*

**38:1** Saad. By renowned kran.

صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ

**38:2** Siyas am-towen yakaein nisesus steeped wa- arrogans e depians.

بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ

**38:3** Amawan babaw generations hav we gulek kweiboug tem? Tasiyas kried out asinavin kawegeis was singay lat to sawl.

كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ

**38:4** E tasiyas marveled towen warner has am to tem prom among tem. Disbelievers said, “towen ses lying magisian.”

وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ

**38:5** “Bo ivag towen kanavin babaw yowbad siw wanuwan kweitan Yowbad? Towen ses kweitan youd gulagul.”

أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ

**38:6** Notables among tem announsed: “go wakunuwatan, e yous nuwanaw to your yowbad. Towen ses kweitan youd planned.

وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ

**38:7** We nag kweitan tut heard op towen wa- pormer simounid. Towen ses nag ge pabrikation.

مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ

**38:8** Was bulagan sent watinow to towen, out op babaw op us?” wa- livan, tasiyas nisesus doubtpul op my katiboug nuwan. Wa- livan, tasiyas hav nag yet amnan my punisment.

أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ

**38:9** Adok vag tasiyas possess treasuries op nok nuwan op your Guyaw — mayestik, giver?

أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ

**38:10** Adok vag tasiyas possess sovereignty op libalab e pwepway e what ses wanuwein tem? Mo let tem mwen balawn.

أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ

**38:11** Army op konpederates son be depeated one.

جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

**38:12** Kweiboug tem gamag op Noah denied kamounid; bo ivag Aad, e Pharaoh op stakes.

وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ

**38:15** Yamwag kadilok dok amav katanok skream, prom amata- one ses nag rekovery.

وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ

**38:16** E tasiyas dibek, “our Guyaw, hasten your writ upon us, kweiboug yam op akkount.”

**38:17** Be kapatul wa- lal op what tasiyas dibek, e mention our servant Deibid, resoursepul. Towen was obedient.

ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

**38:18** We kommitted kaytet to gloripy son towen, wa- kwayav e wa- daybreak.

**38:19** E alen, katakunouk sisiyas. Babaw obedient to towen.

وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ

**38:20** E we katimweis his kingdom, e bo isek towen sinap e desisiv aga-.

وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ

**38:21** Has kwaneib op akweiy disputants token yakamiy? Asinavin tasiyas skaled sanktuary?

۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ

**38:22** Asinavin tasiyas siw upon Deibid, e towen was startled by tem. Tasiyas said, “vag nag goul. Akweiy disputants; kweitan op us has bol oter; so kaleiwag wanuwein us pairly, e vag nag be biased, e katimlakay us to damoms ked.”

إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ

**38:23** “Towen broter op min has ninety nin ewes, e i hav kweitan ewe, e towen said, ‘entrust kawegeis to yeg,' e towen pressured yeg son livan.”

قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩

**38:26** “O Deibid, we mad yakamiy ruler wa- dibwanoug, so kaleiwag wanuwein gamag son yustis, e vag nag bukun met, awoum kawegeis diverts yakamiy prom Yowbad ked. Siyas am-towen stray prom Yowbad ked nanon hav mamayuy punisment, giyan having ignored yam op akkount.”

وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

**38:28** Adok nisesus we to treat siyas am-towen kamiyeb e vag rigteous deeds gig siyas am-towen bub troubl wakunuwatan pwepway? Adok nisesus we to treat pious gig sameless?

**38:29** Blessed buk towen we sent watinow to yakamiy, towen tasiyas may kanuway kawegeis verses, e giyan siyas son intelligens to kew towen.

**38:30** E we granted Deibid, Solomon, ekssellent servant. Towen was penitent.

**38:32** Towen said, “i hav preperred pwakit op niseties to remembrans op my Guyaw — ee kawegeis disappeared kuyeim veil.

**38:33** Bring tem kuyeim to yeg.” e towen began karessing teir legs e kayon.

رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ

**38:34** We tested Solomon, e kab- won wakunuwatan his tron; mo towen repented.

وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

**38:35** Towen said, “my Guyaw, porgiv yeg, e grant yeg kingdom nag kweitan tut to be attained by anyon apter yeg. Yakamiy nisesus giver.”

**38:36** So we kab- yag wa- his servis, blowing gently by his kommand, wherever towen katidumwal.

**38:37** E demons — katanok katanok builder e diver.

**38:38** E oters pettered wa- kains.

**38:39** “Towen ses our gipt; so sek generously, adok withold; witout akkount.”

هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

**38:40** Giyan towen ses nearness to us, e beautipul resort.

**38:41** E mention our servant Job, asinavin towen dow out to his Guyaw, “Seitan has applikted yeg son hardsip e ged.”

**38:43** E we restored his pamily giyan towen, e teir gig son tem; nok nuwan prom us, e lesson giyan siyas am-towen possess insigt.

**38:44** “Kew son your nim bundl, e way son kawegeis, e vag nag kanop your tabudabod.” we ban towen kapatul. What ekssellent servant! Towen was obedient.

**38:45** E mention our servants Ebelam, Aysak, e Jacob — endowed son ability e vision.

وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ

**38:46** We distinguised tem son distinkt kality: remembrans op ven.

إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ

**38:47** To us tasiyas nisesus among kosen, outstanding.

وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

**38:48** E mention Ishmael, Ilays, e Ezekiel; babaw nisesus among outstanding.

وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

**38:49** Towen ses reminder. Devout nanon hav bwein kab- op siwlayum.

هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ

**38:50** Bag op eden, son teir koukwed kupakop-open giyan tem.

جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ

**38:51** Relaksing terein, e dow giyan abundant anagin e beverag.

مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ

**38:52** Son tem nanon be attendants son modest gas, op katanok-wan anbweilim.

۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

**38:53** Towen ses what yakamiy nisesus katagik giyan yam op akkount.

هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

**38:54** Suk ses our bounty, inekshaustibl.

إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ

**38:55** Babaw towen. Ge transgressors nanon hav miserabl siwlayum.

هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ

**38:56** Wadiginasim; wa- amata- tasiyas nanon roast; what miserabl abod!

جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

**38:57** Babaw towen. Let tem amnan kawegeis — boiling e yayan lalawen.

هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ

**38:58** E similar torments op divers kinds.

وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ

**38:59** “Towen ses gamag babaw rusing headlong son yakamiy.” one ses nag welkom giyan tem. Tasiyas nanon be skorked by kov.

هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ

**38:60** Tasiyas nanon dibek, “ge kawegeis ses yakamiy! One ses nag welkom giyan yakamiy! Kawegeis ses yakamiy am-towen brougt kawegeis upon us! What miserabl end!”

قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

**38:61** Tasiyas nanon dibek, “our Guyaw, kal brougt towen upon us, sek towen doubl torment wa- kov.”

قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ

**38:62** E tasiyas nanon dibek, “what ses kawegeis son us towen we vag nag kin tawaw we used to vin among wikked?

وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ

**38:63** Bo ivag we kew tem giyan mokkery, adok hav our mat swerved prom tem?

أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ

**38:64** Towen ses bo magene — peuding op gamag op kov.

إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ

**38:65** Dibek, “i am amav warner, e one ses nag yowbad tage nag Yowbad — kweitan, konkeror.

قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

**38:66** Guyaw op libalab e pwepway, e everyting wanuwein tem; migty, porgiver.”

رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ

**38:67** Dibek, “kawegeis ses bulagan op avakaein importans.

قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ

**38:68** Prom amata- yakamiy nisesus kanavin move.

أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

**38:69** I hav nag sinap op higest assembly tasiyas disput.

مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

**38:70** Kawegeis ses amav kamtel to yeg towen i am gimagim warner.”

إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

**38:71** Your Guyaw said to takayob, “i am bub gamag being prom bidapwat.

إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ

**38:72** Asinavin i hav pormed towen, e breated siw wanuwan towen op my kululuwan, pall prostrat kweiboug towen.

فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

**38:73** So takayob pell prostrat, babaw op tem.

فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

**38:74** Tage nag giyan Seitan. Towen was singay proud, e kweitan op paitless.

إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

**38:75** Towen said, “o Seitan, what gidem yakamiy prom prostrating kweiboug what i bub son my own nim? Nisesus yakamiy singay proud, adok wer yakamiy kweitan op eksalted?”

قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ

**38:76** Towen said, “i am bwein tan towen; yakamiy bub yeg prom kov, e yakamiy bub towen prom bidapwat.”

قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ

**38:77** Towen said, “mo get out op keikay! Yakamiy nisesus outkast!

قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ

**38:78** E my bulet nanon be upon yakamiy ee yam op yudgment.”

وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

**38:79** Towen said, “Guyaw, deper yeg ee yam tasiyas nisesus resurrekted.”

قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

**38:80** Towen said, “yakamiy nisesus kweitan op siyas deperred.

قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

**38:81** Ee yam op tut appointed.”

إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

**38:82** Towen said, “by your mayesty, i nanon sedus tem babaw.

قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**38:83** Tage nag giyan your loyal servants among tem.”

إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

**38:84** Towen said, “ kamounid ses, e i dibek kamounid.

قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ

**38:85** I nanon pill wadiginasim son yakamiy, e son katanok katanok kweitan op tem am-towen bukun yakamiy.”

لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

**38:86** Dibek, “i gan op yakamiy nag wag giyan towen, e i am nag pretender.

قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

**38:87** Kawegeis ses ge reminder to mankind.

إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**38:88** E yakamiy nanon kakin kawegeis bulagan apter whil.”

وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ

## 39. Az-Zumar

**ٱلزُّمَر** · Az-Zumar · Meka waseg · 75 ayat

*Trongs siw paradis wa- kompanies — e vers op namis giyan siyas am-towen hav bo ivag bol.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Yowbad yagan waseg, Siwyoub, Nok Nuwan*

**39:1** Revelation op buk ses prom Yowbad, migty e wis.

تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

**39:2** We sent watinow to yakamiy buk son kamounid, so kanow aygan Yowbad, devoting your religion to towen.

إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

**39:3** Ses nag to Yowbad towen sinser simounid ses due? Giyan siyas am-towen kew guardians dadan towen, “we amav yakawn tem towen tasiyas may bring us nearer to Yowbad.” Yowbad nanon kaleiwag wanuwein tem regarding teir dipperenses. Yowbad vag nag katimlakay lying blaspemer.

أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ

**39:4** Kukin Yowbad sivinan to hav son, towen kould hav selekted prom his kreation wa- nanon. Yakawn be to towen. Towen ses Yowbad, kweitan, prevailing.

لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًۭا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

**39:5** Towen bub libalab e pwepway son silawun. Towen wraps boug leb yam, e towen wraps yam leb boug. E towen regulates kalas e kwel, katanok katanok sawl along spesipik kours. Towen ses bo almigty, porgiver.

خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ

**39:6** Towen bub yakamiy prom kweitan gamag, mo mad prom kawegeis kawegeis mat, e brougt watinow livestokk giyan yakamiy — eigt kinds wa- pairs. Towen bub yakamiy wa- sinvanun op your inan, wa- suksessiv pormations, wa- tripl darkness. Suk ses Yowbad, your Guyaw. His ses kingdom. One ses nag yowbad ge towen. So what mad yakamiy deviat?

خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًۭا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ ثَلَٰثٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ

**39:7** Kukin yakamiy yakaein, Yowbad ses independent op yakamiy, yet towen vag nag approv ingratitud wakunuwatan part op his servants. E kukin yakamiy nisesus tankpul, towen nanon approv towen wa- yakamiy. Nag bearer op burden kadilok bear burden op kweitan. Mo to your Guyaw ses your siwlayum; e towen nanon dibek yakamiy op what yakamiy used to vag. Towen ses awar op what ikuyak kontain.

إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

**39:8** Asinavin musinis adversity kabikon gamag being, towen nitoug to his Guyaw, repenting to towen. Ge mo, asinavin towen konpers wakunuwatan towen gras op his, towen numlev what towen was nitoug giyan kweiboug, e towen attributes rivals to Yowbad, wa- kaleiwag to mgwey astray prom his ked. Dibek, “enyoy your disbeliep giyan kakit whil; yakamiy nanon be among inmates op kov.”

۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ

**39:9** Ses towen am-towen yakawn devoutly igawa kakin op boug, prostrating dimlen e tabalawaw wanakaew, mindpul op hereapter, e kab- his namis wa- nok nuwan op his Guyaw? Dibek, “nisesus siyas am-towen kakin e siyas am-towen vag nag kakin ekal?” amav siyas possessed op silawun nanon nuw.

أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًۭا وَقَآئِمًۭا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

**39:10** Dibek, “o my devotees am-towen hav kamiyeb, keep your duty to your Guyaw. Giyan siyas am-towen vag bwein wa- towen ven watinow, ses goodness. E Yowbad pwepway ses vast. Steadpast nanon be paid teir maysan wa- kalawt, witout rekkoning.”

قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

**39:11** Dibek, “i was kommanded to kanow aygan Yowbad, devoting my religion eksklusively to towen.

**39:46** Dibek, “our Yowbad, initiator op libalab e pwepway, knower op babaw sekrets e deklarations. Yakamiy nanon kaleiwag wanuwein your servants regarding what tasiyas had dippered about.”

قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

**39:47** Kukin siyas am-towen bo ivag bol owned everyting wakunuwatan pwepway, e gig op kawegeis son kawegeis, tasiyas would redeem tatineis son kawegeis prom terribl gidaged won wakunuwatan yam op resurrektion. Ge one nanon appear to tem prom Yowbad what tasiyas nag kweitan tut antisipated.

وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ

**39:48** One nanon appear to tem kalbaleb op teir deeds, e tasiyas nanon be surrounded by what tasiyas used to gin.

وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**39:49** Asinavin adversity kabikon gamag being, towen dow wakunuwatan us. Ge mo, asinavin we pavor towen son blessing prom us, towen dibek, “i hav attained towen by virtu op my sinap.” however, kawegeis ses test, ge avakaein op tem vag nag kakin.

فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَٰهُ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**39:50** Siyas kweiboug tem said kawegeis, ge what tasiyas had earned bo ivag nag avail tem.

قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**39:51** Kalbaleb op teir deeds kaugt wanakaew son tem. E wrongdoers among yamwag nanon may be applikted by kalbaleb op what tasiyas earned, e tasiyas kannot gidem kawegeis.

فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

**39:52** Vag tasiyas nag kakin towen Yowbad ekstends provision to whomever towen nanon, e konstrikts kawegeis? Wa- towen nisesus mulin giyan gamag am-towen kamiyeb.

أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

**39:53** Dibek, “o my servants am-towen hav transgressed against tatineis: vag nag despair op Yowbad nok nuwan, giyan Yowbad porgives babaw sins. Towen ses bo porgiver, klement.”

۞ قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

**39:54** E kanavin to your Guyaw, e tam to towen, kweiboug retribution am upon yakamiy. Mo yakamiy nanon nag be lab.

وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ

**39:55** E bukun bwein singay op what was kamtel to yakamiy prom your Guyaw, kweiboug punisment am upon yakamiy suddenly, whil yakamiy nisesus unawar.

وَٱتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةًۭ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

**39:56** So towen soul may nag dibek, “amawan sorry i am, giyan having sigan my duty to Yowbad, e giyan having been op skoppers.”

أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌۭ يَٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّٰخِرِينَ

**39:57** Adok dibek, “had Yowbad katimlakay yeg; i would hav been op pious.”

أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

**39:58** Adok dibek, asinavin kawegeis kin penalty, “kukin amav i had kweitan kans, i would be op virtuous.”

أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةًۭ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

**39:59** Yes bo! My verses bo ivag am to yakamiy, ge yakamiy dow tem yaweid, kanavin arrogant, e wer op paitless.

بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

**39:60** Wakunuwatan yam op resurrektion, yakamiy nanon kin siyas am-towen told yaweid about Yowbad son teir lal blakkened. Ses one nag kab- wa- wadiginasim giyan arrogant?

وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

**39:61** E Yowbad nanon katimov siyas am-towen maintained rigteousness to teir kab- op salvation. Nag yableb nanon kabikon tem, nor nanon tasiyas griev.

وَيُنَجِّى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

**39:62** Yowbad ses kreator op babaw wuliyoug, e towen ses wa- karg op babaw wuliyoug.

ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَكِيلٌۭ

**39:63** To towen belong reins op libalab e pwepway. Ge siyas am-towen blaspem against revelations op Yowbad — kawegeis ses tasiyas am-towen nisesus losers.

لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ

**39:64** Dibek, “ses kawegeis oter tan Yowbad yakamiy instrukt yeg to yakawn, yakamiy matapwad wakunuwatan?”

قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ

**39:65** Kawegeis was kamtel to yakamiy, e to siyas kweiboug yakamiy, towen kukin yakamiy idolis, your wotet nanon be wa- vain, e yakamiy nanon be op losers.

وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ

**39:66** Rater, yakawn Yowbad, e be op appresiativ.

بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ

**39:67** Tasiyas hav nag esteemed Yowbad towen ougt to be esteemed. Son pwepway nanon be wa- his grip wakunuwatan yam op resurrektion, e libalab nanon be polded wa- his rig. Immakulat ses towen, e transsendent towen ses beyond assosiations tasiyas bub.

وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًۭا قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

**39:68** E trumpet nanon be sounded, whereupon everyon wa- libalab e pwepway nanon be stunned, tage nag whomever Yowbad nanon. Mo kawegeis nanon be sounded kweitan tut, whereupon tasiyas nanon kit wanakaew, looking wakunuwatan.

وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌۭ يَنظُرُونَ

**39:69** E pwepway nanon sin son gagab op kawegeis Guyaw; e buk nanon be put wa- kab-; e palopit e witnesses nanon be brougt wa-; e yudgment nanon be passed among tem ekitably, e tasiyas nanon nag be bol.

وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

**39:70** E katanok katanok soul nanon be pully kompensated giyan what kawegeis had bo ivag. Towen ses bwein awar op what tasiyas vag.

وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ

**39:71** Siyas am-towen yakaein nanon be driven to wadiginasim wa- trongs. Ee, asinavin tasiyas hav token kawegeis, e kawegeis koukwed nisesus opened, kawegeis keepers nanon dibek to tem, “bo ivag nag takayob prom among yakamiy am to yakamiy, resiting to yakamiy revelations op your Guyaw, e katiboug nuwan yakamiy op kalivet op towen yam op yours?” tasiyas nanon dibek, “yes, ge verdikt op punisment ses yustipied against disbelievers.”

وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

**39:72** Kawegeis nanon be said, “siw koukwed op wadiginasim, to abid terein eternally.” amawan wretked ses destination op arrogant.

قِيلَ ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

**39:73** E siyas am-towen goul teir Guyaw nanon be led to paradis wa- trongs. Ee, asinavin tasiyas hav token kawegeis, e kawegeis koukwed nisesus opened, kawegeis keepers nanon dibek to tem, “niwal be upon yakamiy, yakamiy hav been bwein, so siw kawegeis, to abid terein eternally.”

وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ

**39:74** E tasiyas nanon dibek, “kamumwan be to Yowbad, am-towen has pulpilled his katagik to us, e mad us inherit dibwanoug, enyoying paradis we pleas.” amawan ekssellent ses anagin op workers.

وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ

**39:75** E yakamiy nanon kin takayob hovering leb tron, gloripying teir Guyaw son kamumwan. E kawegeis nanon be kaleiwag wanuwein tem ekitably, e kawegeis nanon be said, “kamumwan be to Yowbad, Guyaw op ven watinow.”

وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

---

## 40. Ghafir

**غَافِر** · Ghafir · Meka waseg · 85 ayat

*Porgiver: believer wa- Pharaoh's pak am-towen wage asinavin silens was saper.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Yowbad yagan waseg, Siwyoub, Nok Nuwan*

**40:1** Ha, meem.

حمٓ

**40:2** Sending watinow op skriptur ses prom Yowbad almigty, omnissient.

تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

**40:3** Porgiver op sins, aksepter op repentans, singay avakaein wa- punisment, bountipul wa- bounty. One ses nag yowbad ge towen. To towen ses ultimat siwlayum.

غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

**40:4** Naga tonen kamimen against Yowbad revelations tage nag siyas am-towen yakaein. So vag nag be impressed by teir aktivities wa- dibwanoug.

مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

**40:5** Kweiboug tem gamag op Noah peiyaw kamounid, bo ivag konpederates apter tem. Katanok katanok kommunity plotted against teir takayob, to kwey towen. E tasiyas kamimen son palsehood, to depeat son kawegeis kamounid. Ge i yous tem. What punisment kawegeis was!

كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

**40:6** Mamagin sentens op your Guyaw bekam realised against siyas am-towen yakaein, towen tasiyas nisesus to be inmates op kov.

وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

**40:7** Siyas am-towen kew tron, e siyas leb kawegeis, gloripy teir Guyaw son kamumwan, e kamiyeb wa- towen, e gan giyan porgiveness giyan siyas am-towen kamiyeb: “our Guyaw, yakamiy hav enkompassed everyting wa- nok nuwan e sinap; so porgiv siyas am-towen repent e bukun your ked, e protekt tem prom agony op blas.

يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَٰعٌۭ وَإِنَّ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ

**40:40** Kal kommits sin nanon be repaid amav son kawegeis gig. Ge kal wotet rigteousness, wheter mal adok pemal, e ses believer — yamwag nanon siw paradis, ama- tasiyas nanon be provided giyan witout akkount.

مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةًۭ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

**40:41** O my gamag, amawan ses kawegeis towen i dow yakamiy to salvation, e yakamiy dow yeg to kov?

۞ وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

**40:42** Yakamiy dow yeg to peiyaw Yowbad, e to assosiat son towen what i hav nag sinap op, whil i dow yakamiy to migty porgiver.

تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّٰرِ

**40:43** Witout doubt, what yakamiy dow yeg to has nag dibek wa- towen ven watinow, adok wa- hereapter; e our kanavin kuyeim ses to Yowbad; e transgressors nisesus inmates op kov.

لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

**40:44** Yakamiy nanon nuw what i am dibek yakamiy, so i kommit my didawag to Yowbad. Yowbad ses observant op servants.”

فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

**40:45** So Yowbad protekted towen prom kalbaleb op teir skeming, whil terribl torment besieged Pharaoh's klan.

فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ

**40:46** Kov. Tasiyas nanon be eksposed to kawegeis gaboug e kwayav. E wakunuwatan yam awa kew kab-: “admit klan op Pharaoh to avakaein intens agony.”

ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّۭا وَعَشِيًّۭا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ

**40:47** Tasiyas karrel wa- kov, gwey nanon dibek to siyas am-towen wer arrogant, “we wer pollowers op yours; nanon yakamiy mo spar us ivisan op kov?”

وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ

**40:48** Siyas am-towen wer arrogant nanon dibek, “we nisesus babaw wa- kawegeis; Yowbad has kaleiwag wanuwein servants.”

قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُلٌّۭ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ

**40:49** E siyas wa- kov nanon dibek to keepers op wadiginasim, “dow to your Guyaw to lessen our gidaged won giyan kweitan yam.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ

**40:50** Tasiyas nanon dibek, “bo ivag nag your takayob am to yakamiy son gimagim mulin?” tasiyas nanon dibek, “yes.” tasiyas nanon dibek, “mo nitoug, ge prayers op disbelievers nanon tuta babaw be wa- vain.”

قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُوا۟ فَٱدْعُوا۟ ۗ وَمَا دُعَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ

**40:51** Avakaein surely we nanon support our takayob e siyas am-towen kamiyeb, wa- towen mwamovan, e wakunuwatan yam witnesses aris.

إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ

**40:52** Yam asinavin teir ekskuses nanon nag propit wrongdoers, e bulet nanon be upon tem, e tasiyas nanon hav ven op misery.

يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ

**40:53** We bo isek Moses guidans, e mad gamagal op Yisleil inherit skriptur.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ

**40:54** Katimlakay e reminder giyan siyas endowed son silawun.

هُدًۭى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

**40:55** So be kapatul. Katagik op Yowbad ses magene. E gan porgiveness giyan your sin, e proklaim kamumwan op your Guyaw kwayav e gaboug.

فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَٰرِ

**40:56** Siyas am-towen disput regarding Yowbad revelations witout kweitan kaleiwag having am to tem — one ses nag wa- teir ikuyak ge peeling op greatness, amata- tasiyas nanon nag kweitan tut attain. So nev repug wa- Yowbad; giyan towen ses babaw-kataluteg, babaw-kin.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌۭ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

**40:57** Bo kreation op libalab e pwepway ses greater tan kreation op humanity, ge avakaein gamag vag nag kakin.

لَخَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

**40:58** Nag ekal nisesus kaguligwal e kin. Nor nisesus siyas am-towen kamiyeb e wotet rigteousness ekal to sinners. Amawan kakit yakamiy replekt.

وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

**40:59** Bo, awa ses am; one ses nag doubt about kawegeis; ge avakaein gamag vag nag kamiyeb.

إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

**40:60** Your Guyaw has said, “nitoug to yeg, e i nanon respond to yakamiy. Ge siyas am-towen nisesus singay proud to yakawn yeg nanon siw wadiginasim porsibly.”

وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ

**40:61** Kawegeis ses Yowbad am-towen mad boug giyan yakamiy, towen yakamiy may rest terein; e yam allowing sigt. Yowbad ses grasious towards gamag, ge avakaein gamag vag nag sek tanks.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

**40:62** Suk ses Yowbad, your Guyaw, kreator op babaw wuliyoug. One ses nag yowbad tage nag towen; so amawan kould yakamiy kanavin move?

ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ

**40:63** Mamagin nisesus kanavin move siyas am-towen disput mulin op Yowbad.

كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

**40:64** Kawegeis ses Yowbad am-towen mad pwepway habitat giyan yakamiy, e libalab struktur. E towen designed yakamiy, e designed yakamiy bwein; e towen provided yakamiy son bwein wuliyoug. Suk ses Yowbad, your Guyaw; so blessed ses Yowbad, Guyaw op ven watinow.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًۭا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءًۭ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**40:65** Towen ses mov kweitan. One ses nag yowbad tage nag towen. So nitoug to towen, devoting your religion to towen. Kamumwan be to Yowbad, Guyaw op ven watinow.

هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ۗ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**40:66** Dibek, “i was prohibited prom yakawn siyas yakamiy invok dadan Yowbad, mwana towen gimagim revelations hav am to yeg prom my Guyaw; e i was kommanded to tam to Guyaw op ven watinow.”

۞ قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**40:67** Kawegeis ses towen am-towen bub yakamiy prom musamus, mo prom kaytul, mo prom embryo, mo towen brings yakamiy out inpant, mo towen lets yakamiy token your maturity, mo yakamiy mlavag elderly — altoug musinis op yakamiy kanig sooner — so towen yakamiy may token predetermined anbweilim, so towen yakamiy may kabunik.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًۭا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًۭا مُّسَمًّۭى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

**40:68** Kawegeis ses towen am-towen sek mwamovan e kanig; e asinavin towen desides wakunuwatan vavag, towen deisa dibek to kawegeis, “be,” e kawegeis am to be.

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

**40:69** Hav yakamiy nag observed siyas am-towen disput regarding Yowbad revelations, amawan tasiyas hav deviated?

أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ

**40:70** Siyas am-towen dow buk yaweid, e what we sent our takayob son — tasiyas nanon surely kakin.

ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

**40:71** Asinavin yokes nisesus leb teir kayon, e tasiyas nanon be dragged by kains.

إِذِ ٱلْأَغْلَٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ

**40:72** Siw wanuwan boiling giseil, mo wa- kov tasiyas nanon be konsumed.

فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ

**40:73** Mo kawegeis nanon be said to tem, “ama- nisesus siyas yakamiy used to deipy?

ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ

**40:74** Instead op Yowbad?” tasiyas nanon dibek, “tasiyas hav piyev us. Wa- livan, we wer nitoug to nag kweiboug.” mamagin Yowbad sends disbelievers astray.

مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

**40:75** Towen ses peinan yakamiy used to reyois wakunuwatan pwepway wa- oter tan kamounid, e peinan yakamiy used to behav son vanity.

ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ

**40:76** Siw koukwed op wadiginasim, to remain terein bisigeg. What terribl dwelling giyan arrogant.

ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

**40:77** So be kapatul. Katagik op Yowbad ses magene. Wheter we kamtel yakamiy musinis op what we hav katagik tem, adok kew yakamiy to us, to us tasiyas nanon be siwlayum.

فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

**40:78** We sent takayob kweiboug yakamiy. Musinis op tem we told yakamiy about, e musinis we bo ivag nag dibek yakamiy about. Nag takayob kadilok bring mirakl tage nag by leav op Yowbad. Mo, asinavin kommand op Yowbad ses issued, pair yudgment nanon be passed, e one e mo seekers op vanity nanon los.

وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًۭا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

**40:79** Yowbad ses towen am-towen bub domestik animals giyan yakamiy — musinis giyan yakamiy to sisawl, e musinis yakamiy kam.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

**40:80** E wa- tem yakamiy hav oter peinan bwein, e troug tem yakamiy satispy your sivinan. E wakunuwatan tem, e wakunuwatan sip, yakamiy nisesus transported.

وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةًۭ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

**40:81** E towen kamtel yakamiy his mulin. So amata- op Yowbad mulin nanon yakamiy kayan?

وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَأَىَّ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ

**40:82** Hav tasiyas nag yourneyed troug dibwanoug, e seen outkom giyan siyas kweiboug tem? Tasiyas wer singay numerous tan tasiyas, e had greater tawtoun e inpluens wa- dibwanoug. Ge what tasiyas had akieved availed tem nag.

أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةًۭ وَءَاثَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**40:83** Asinavin teir takayob neim to tem son gimagim proops, tasiyas reyoised wa- sinap tasiyas had, e singay wuliyoug tasiyas used to gin besieged tem.

فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

**40:84** Mo, asinavin tasiyas witnessed our adok, tasiyas said, “we kamiyeb wa- Yowbad anmwanet, e we peiyaw what we used to assosiat son towen.”

فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشْرِكِينَ

**40:85** Ge teir simounid kould nag lab tem sivatan tasiyas witnessed our adok. Towen has been Yowbad ked op dealing son his servants. E one e mo disbelievers kanig.

فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

## 41. Fussilat

**فُصِّلَت** · Fussilat · Meka waseg · 54 ayat

*Detailed: mulin eksplained, e gamag am-towen said our ikuyak nisesus under koverings.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Yowbad yagan waseg, Siwyoub, Nok Nuwan*

**41:1** Ha, meem.

حمٓ

**41:2** Revelation prom siwyoub, nok nuwan.

تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

**41:3** Skriptur whos verses nisesus detailed, kran wa- arabik giyan gamag am-towen kakin.

كِتَٰبٌۭ فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ

**41:4** Bringing bwein bulagan, e sek warnings. Ge avakaein op tem kanavin move, so tasiyas vag nag kataligen.

بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

**41:5** E tasiyas dibek, “our ikuyak nisesus skreened prom what yakamiy dow us to, e wa- our teg ses deapness, e wanuwein us e yakamiy ses barrier. So vag what yakamiy sivinan, e so nanon we.”

وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ أَكِنَّةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌۭ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌۭ فَٱعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَٰمِلُونَ

**41:6** Dibek, “i am amav gamag gig yakamiy; kawegeis ses inspired wa- yeg towen your Yowbad ses kweitan Yowbad. So be didumwal towards towen, e nev porgiveness prom towen.” e woe to idolaters.

قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ

**41:7** Siyas am-towen vag nag muloul; e regarding hereapter, tasiyas nisesus disbelievers.

ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ

**41:8** Giyan siyas am-towen kamiyeb e vag rigteous deeds — giyan tem ses anagin uninterrupted.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ

**41:9** Dibek, “vag yakamiy peiyaw kweitan am-towen bub pwepway wa- akweiy yam? E yakamiy attribut ekals to towen? Towen ses Guyaw op univers.”

۞ قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

**41:10** Towen kab- stabilisers over kawegeis; e blessed kawegeis; e planned kawegeis provisions wa- kweivas yam, ekally to seekers.

وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍۢ سَوَآءًۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ

**41:11** Mo towen kanavin to libalab, e kawegeis was smok, e said to kawegeis e to pwepway, “am, willingly adok unwillingly.” tasiyas said, “we am willingly.”

ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌۭ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًۭا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ

**41:12** So towen iwnawes tem seven universes wa- akweiy yam, e towen assigned to katanok katanok univers kawegeis kaleiwag. E we dekorated lower univers son lamps, e giyan protektion. Towen ses design op almigty, babaw-kakin.

فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَاتٍۢ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

**41:13** Ge kukin tasiyas kanavin move, dibek, “i hav katiboug nuwan yakamiy op tunderbolt, gig tunderbolt op Aad e Thamud.”

فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَٰعِقَةًۭ مِّثْلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٍۢ وَثَمُودَ

**41:14** Teir takayob neim to tem, prom kweiboug tem e prom kuyeim tem, dibek, “vag nag yakawn anyon ge Yowbad.” tasiyas said, “had our Guyaw nanon, towen would hav sent watinow takayob; mapun, we peiyaw what yakamiy nisesus sent son.”

إِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

**41:15** Giyan Aad, tasiyas kanavin arrogant wakunuwatan pwepway, e opposed yustis, e said, “am-towen ses singay powerpul tan us?” hav tasiyas nag dik towen Yowbad, am-towen bub tem, ses singay powerpul tan tasiyas? E tasiyas bo inoun wakunuwatan kayan our revelations.

فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

**41:16** So we unleased upon tem skreaming yag, giyan pew miserabl yam, to bub tem amnan punisment op sam wa- towen mwamovan; ge punisment op hereapter ses singay samepul; e tasiyas nanon nag be katimov.

فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍۢ نَّحِسَاتٍۢ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

**41:17** E giyan Thamud, we katimlakay tem, ge tasiyas preperred blindness over guidans. So tunderbolt op humiliating punisment yous tem, peinan op what tasiyas used to earn.

وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

**41:18** E we katimov siyas am-towen kamiyeb e wer rigteous.

وَنَجَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ

**41:19** Yam asinavin Yowbad tameiliw nisesus herded siw wanuwan kov, porsibly.

وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

**41:20** Ee, asinavin tasiyas hav token kawegeis, teir kataluteg, e teir sigt, e teir kaleivin nanon testipy against tem regarding what tasiyas used to vag.

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**41:21** E tasiyas nanon dibek to teir kaleivin, “why bo ivag yakamiy testipy against us?” tasiyas nanon dibek, “Yowbad, am-towen mad babaw wuliyoug kawsiyeg, mad us kawsiyeg. Kawegeis ses towen am-towen bub yakamiy gin- tut, e to towen yakamiy nisesus siwlayum.”

وَقَالُوا۟ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

**41:22** Yakamiy wer unabl to kawum yourselves prom your kataluteg, e your sigt, e your kaleivin, to gidem tem prom testipying against yakamiy, e yakamiy imagined towen Yowbad was unawar op mananan op what yakamiy vag.

وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًۭا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

**41:23** Kawegeis ses towen tougt op yours about your Guyaw towen led yakamiy to ruin — so yakamiy bekam op losers.

وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ

**41:24** Kukin tasiyas endur patiently, kov nanon be teir residens; e kukin tasiyas bub wanakaew ekskuses, tasiyas nanon nag be pardoned.

فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا۟ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًۭى لَّهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا۟ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُعْتَبِينَ

**41:25** We had assigned sideyas giyan tem, am-towen glamorised to tem what was wa- wamatan op tem, e what was kuyeim tem. E livan proved magene against tem wa- kommunities op yinn e gamag towen hav passed move kweiboug tem. Tasiyas wer losers.

۞ وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوا۟ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍۢ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَٰسِرِينَ

**41:26** Siyas am-towen yakaein dibek, “vag nag kataligen to towen kran, e talk over kawegeis, so towen yakamiy may prevail.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ

**41:27** We nanon bub siyas am-towen yakaein amnan intens agony, e we nanon rekompens tem akkording to worst op what tasiyas used to vag.

فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

**41:28** Suk ses rekompens op Yowbad tameiliw — kov — ama- tasiyas nanon hav teir permanent ven, wa- rekompens giyan having disregarded our revelations.

ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعْدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ۖ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

**41:29** Siyas am-towen yakaein nanon dibek, “our Guyaw, kamtel us siyas am-towen led us astray — among yinn e gamag — e we nanon trampl tem under our peet, so tasiyas mlavag among op lowest.”

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ

**41:30** Surely, siyas am-towen dibek: “our Guyaw ses Yowbad,” e mo go damoms, takayob nanon bus upon tem: “vag nag goul, e vag nag griev, ge reyois wa- bulagan op bag amata- yakamiy wer katagik.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

**41:31** We nisesus your allies wa- towen mwamovan e wa- hereapter, wherein yakamiy nanon hav whatever your souls met, e yakamiy nanon hav terein whatever yakamiy dow giyan.

نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ

**41:32** Hospitality prom babaw-porgiving, nok nuwan kweitan.”

نُزُلًۭا مِّنْ غَفُورٍۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ

**41:33** E am-towen ses bwein wa- aga- tan someon am-towen dow to Yowbad, e nuwek son integrity, e dibek, “i am op siyas am-towen tam”?

وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًۭا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

**41:34** Bwein e kalbaleb nisesus nag ekal. Repel kalbaleb son bwein, e gamag am-towen was your tameiliw mlavag gig intimat veiyon.

وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌۭ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌۭ

**41:35** Ge naga tonen nanon attain kawegeis tage nag siyas am-towen persever, e naga tonen nanon attain kawegeis tage nag singay portunat.

وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ

**41:36** Asinavin temptation prom devil provokes yakamiy, nev repug wa- Yowbad; towen ses hearer, knower.

وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ نَزْغٌۭ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

**41:37** E op his mulin nisesus boug e yam, e kalas e kwel. Vag nag bow watinow to kalas, nor to kwel, ge bow watinow to Yowbad, am-towen bub tem bot, kukin kawegeis ses towen towen yakamiy kanow aygan.

وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

**41:38** Ge kukin tasiyas nisesus singay proud — siyas wa- presens op your Guyaw kamumwan towen boug e yam, e witout ever tiring.

فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ ۩

*[Kulul — kaleiwag]*

**41:39** E op his mulin ses towen yakamiy kin dibwanoug ga-. Ge asinavin we send watinow giseil upon kawegeis, kawegeis stirs e katimweis. Surely, towen am-towen revived kawegeis nanon reviv kanig. Towen ses kadilok to vag babaw wuliyoug.

وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَٰشِعَةًۭ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

**41:40** Siyas am-towen despis our revelations nisesus nag hidden prom us. Ses towen am-towen ses hurled siw wanuwan kov bwein? Adok towen am-towen lug sapely wakunuwatan yam op resurrektion? Vag yakamiy pleas; towen ses kin op everyting yakamiy vag.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ ۗ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًۭا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

**41:41** Siyas am-towen peiyaw reminder asinavin kawegeis has am to tem — kawegeis ses invinsibl buk.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزٌۭ

**41:42** Palsehood kannot approak kawegeis, prom kweiboug kawegeis adok kuyeim kawegeis. Kawegeis ses revelation prom kweitan wis e praiseworty.

لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ ۖ تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍۢ

**41:43** Nag ses said to yakamiy ge was said to takayob kweiboug yakamiy: your Guyaw ses possessor op porgiveness, e possessor op mamayuy repayment.

مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ

**41:44** Had we mad kawegeis kran wa- poreign aga-, tasiyas would hav said, “kukin amav kawegeis verses wer mad gimagim.” non-arabik e arab? Dibek, “giyan siyas am-towen kamiyeb, kawegeis ses guidans e healing. Ge giyan siyas am-towen vag nag kamiyeb: one ses heaviness wa- teir teg, e kawegeis ses blindness giyan tem. Yamwag nisesus being dow prom distant kab-.”

وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّۭا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓ ۖ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّۭ وَعَرَبِىٌّۭ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًۭى وَشِفَآءٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌۭ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

**41:45** We bo isek Moses buk, ge disputes aros konserning kawegeis. Wer kawegeis nag giyan prior dekre prom your Guyaw, yudgment would hav been kavteg wanuwein tem. Ge tasiyas nisesus wa- perpleksing doubt konserning kawegeis.

وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍۢ

**41:46** Kal nuwek rigteously vag so giyan dimlen; e kal wotet kalbaleb vag so against dimlen. Your Guyaw ses nag unyust to servants.

مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

**41:47** To towen ses reperred sinap op awa. Nag anagin emerges prom kawegeis seat, e nag pemal konseives adok delivers, tage nag son his sinap. E wakunuwatan yam asinavin towen dow out to tem, “ama- nisesus my assosiates?” tasiyas nanon dibek, “we admit to yakamiy, naga tonen op us ses witness.”

۞ إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۚ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍۢ

**41:48** What tasiyas used to nitoug to kweiboug nanon lisow tem, e tasiyas nanon realis towen tasiyas hav nag sawl.

وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍۢ

**41:49** Gamag being nag kweitan tut tires op nitoug giyan bwein wuliyoug; ge asinavin adversity applikts towen, towen despairs e loses namis.

لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌۭ قَنُوطٌۭ

**41:50** E asinavin we let towen amnan nok nuwan prom us, apter adversity towen had applikted towen, towen nanon dibek, “towen ses min, e i vag nag dik towen awa ses am; e kadilok kukin i am siwlayum to my Guyaw, i nanon hav singay bwein singay son towen.” we nanon dibek siyas am-towen yakaein op what tasiyas bo ivag, e we nanon bub tem amnan awpul punisment.

وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۭ وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ

**41:51** Asinavin we provid komport giyan gamag being, towen witdraws e distanses dimlen; ge asinavin adversity bepalls towen, towen starts lengty prayers.

وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍۢ

**41:52** Dibek, “hav yakamiy dik? Kukin kawegeis ses prom Yowbad e yakamiy peiyaw kawegeis — am-towen ses purter astray tan towen am-towen ses kutopp e alienated?”

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

**41:53** We nanon kamtel tem our proops wakunuwatan horisons, e wa- teir singay souls, ee kawegeis mlavag gimagim to tem towen kawegeis ses kamounid. Ses kawegeis nag kadilok towen your Guyaw ses witness over everyting?

سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْءَافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

**41:54** Surely tasiyas nisesus wa- doubt about enkounter son teir Guyaw. Surely towen komprehends everyting.

أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّحِيطٌۢ
